job.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Platforms
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Lead Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will be one of the technical leads for our DevOps Platforms organization. This group is responsible for DevOps Platforms including cloud infrastructure, physical data center orchestration, critical security services, and our Zoom for Government (ZfG) environment. You will be an uber tech lead working across a broad area, defining projects and guiding work across various teams. Your scope of work is wide and you will have the opportunity to improve our datacenter kubernetes infrastructure, our cloud infrastructure, our security posture, and our operation of ZfG environments. Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE and you will guide all of our teams toward SRE best practices (automation, monitoring, infrastructure as code, etc).

About the Team

The DevOps Platforms organization owns the full infrastructure stack: cloud infrastructure on AWS and OCI, physical data center orchestration, critical security services (identity, authentication, authorization), and Zoom's FedRAMP-rated federal environment, Zoom for Government (ZfG).

The team is currently working on one of the most technically interesting work in the org, hardening our security posture, and building the automation and reliability systems that underpin Zoom's global services. If you want broad visibility, real cross-team influence, and the chance to define how infrastructure gets built, this is the seat.

Responsibilities

  • Design and scale DevOps platform services including Kubernetes infrastructure, cloud systems, and compliance-ready environments
  • Define technical roadmaps and architectural direction for infrastructure automation and security
  • Partner with service teams to understand platform needs and deliver solutions that improve reliability and efficiency
  • Establish and advocate for SRE best practices including infrastructure as code, monitoring, and incident management
  • Mentor team members through design, implementation, and production deployment of complex systems

What We're Looking For

  • Bring 8+ years of SRE or DevOps experience building and operating production infrastructure at scale
  • Code proficiently in at least one programming language beyond scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Java)
  • Deploy and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like Git, Jenkins, Argo CD, or JFrog
  • Operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, OCI, or similar platforms using Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Implement observability solutions with logging and monitoring tools such as ELK, Prometheus, or Grafana
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences including security teams, senior leadership, and external auditors
  • Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response to maintain system reliability
  • Hold a degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Hold US citizenship, or Greencard status

Preferred

  • Have experience with security from an SRE perspective
  • Have experience with Identity security (e.g. IAM, workload identity, zero trust) and tools (e.g. Teleport, Okta)
  • Have experience operating Government environments and understanding their compliance requirements
  • Have experience with system design and distributed computing at scale
  • Ability to speak Chinese/Mandarin is a plus, but not required

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$124,000.00

Maximum:

$271,200.00



In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure;  there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer - Upmarket West
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will serve as the lead technical advocate for our customers, helping them understand and leverage Zoom's architectural advantages while partnering closely with our Upmarket Enterprise and Majors AE teams across the West. This is a role for a well-rounded, technically credible SE who brings broad knowledge across the full UCaaS stack, not just a single product line.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role supporting some of the most complex accounts in the country: enterprise-scale technology companies that demand sophisticated, multi-product solution design.

This role is for a forward-thinking UCaaS generalist with a passion for technology, a customer-first mindset, and a genuine drive to deliver happiness through transformative AI solutions.

About the Team

Supporting Upmarket West accounts, our Solutions Engineering team acts as the strategic and technical backbone for complex enterprise deal cycles. We partner closely with Account Executives to architect full-platform solutions, articulate Zoom’s competitive advantages, and deliver happiness to our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Enterprise and Majors AEs to drive technical sales engagements across the full Zoom platform—including Meetings, Phone, Contact Center, Rooms, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, custom demos, and proofs of concept (POCs) tailored to address complex enterprise collaboration challenges.
  • Serve as the primary technical advocate for our clients, translating customer requirements into product recommendations and driving feature requests internally with Product and Engineering.
  • Articulate Zoom’s architectural advantages, enterprise AI use cases, and broader vision to decision-makers ranging from technical practitioners to executive leadership.
  • Gather market intelligence and competitive insights from field engagements to help refine sales strategies and inform internal roadmaps.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with AEs, product managers, and specialists to manage RFPs/RFQs, remove technical blockers, and accelerate deal cycles.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of solutions engineering experience supporting enterprise-level customers in technical pre-sales, with a strong understanding of the sales cycle and ability to drive urgency at the right moments.
  • Strong working knowledge across the full UCaaS stack—SaaS collaboration, cloud voice, contact center, video, and unified communications—with ability to hit the ground running; generalist profile strongly preferred over narrow specialization.
  • Highly proficient in presenting complex technical solutions, from traditional voice systems to modern cloud platforms, with hands-on familiarity with API integrations, networking protocols, security best practices, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • A genuine passion for AI: not just awareness of the trends, but real use cases, hands-on experience, and the ability to speak to its impact on the modern workforce with conviction.
  • Natural rapport-builder with strong business acumen and executive presence: effective with AEs, executives, and technical stakeholders at every level.

job.title: Manager of Platform DevOps
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will be the leader of our Platforms DevOps team.  This team is responsible for Zoom’s Kubernetes clusters in both datacenters and clouds, as well as for our cloudops infrastructure.  The scope and mandate of the team are broad, and you will have significant opportunities to partner with teams across Engineering, DevOps/SRE, and Security. You'll drive projects that enable new features, improve infrastructure reliability and security, and reduce costs. Within the team, you'll manage technical ICs and continuously improve processes with automation, policy, and AI.

Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE/DevOps leader with expertise running k8s, and knowledge of best practices for IaC, automation, monitoring, and security.  You also have experience communicating nuanced concepts to diverse audiences (e.g. both engineers and senior management). You can balance technical tradeoffs, and can adapt plans to deliver quickly on the most important goals for our customers and partners.

About the Team

We manage Zoom's Kubernetes and cloud operations infrastructure at scale. Our team collaborates across Engineering and Security to automate processes and optimize platform performance. We enable reliable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure for Zoom's global services.

Responsibilities

  • Leading projects that automate infrastructure management and advance the team's Kubernetes and cloud capabilities

  • Identifying and executing cost optimization opportunities across cloud resources and infrastructure

  • Driving security improvements across cloud and Kubernetes assets in partnership with Security teams

  • Collaborating with partner teams and stakeholders to understand needs and build project roadmaps

  • Developing team members and optimizing work processes through mature software practices and continuous improvement

What We're Looking For

  • Hold BS/MS in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Have 5+ years of SRE or DevOps experience managing production infrastructure

  • Lead and develop technical teams with 3+ years of management experience

  • Have experience with at least one programming language, in addition to scripting languages 

  • Have experience with cloud providers (e.g. AWS, OCI) and cloud infrastructure technologies (e.g. Terraform, kubernetes)

  • Demonstrate experience managing Kubernetes from an SRE perspective in production environments

  • Have experience with best practices for Continuous Deployment, including CI/CD tools and version control systems (e.g. Git, Jenkins, Argo CD, JFrog artifactory)

  • Be able to guide releases/deployments and/or participate in on-call shifts/incident response after hours or on weekends

Preferred

  • Have experience with logging and monitoring tools (e.g. ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Have experience with system design and distributed computing at scale

  • Have experience with AI to automate SRE and management tasks

  • Have experience operating k8s in on-prem/colo datacenters

  • Ability to speak Chinese/Mandarin

job.title: Senior Tax Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will support the indirect tax team with end-to-end global indirect tax compliance and advisory across multiple jurisdictions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to automate processes and implement AI-driven tax solutions. You will deliver accurate, timely tax reporting while driving continuous improvement across the tax function.


About the Team

We deliver global indirect tax compliance and strategic tax operations. Our team works collaboratively across timezones to support the company's tax obligations. We exist to ensure tax accuracy and efficiency while enabling business growth.


Responsibilities

  • Managing end-to-end VAT and indirect tax compliance processes across multiple jurisdictions, from data review through submission and payment.
  • Executing VAT and indirect tax accounting processes during month-end and quarter-end close, including controls and management checks.
  • Supporting global e-invoicing, Continuous Transaction Controls, and digital tax reporting requirements.
  • Collaborating with tax technology teams to identify automation opportunities and deliver AI-driven process improvements.
  • Responding to audit requests from tax authorities, third-party auditors, and internal teams while supporting customer-facing teams with tax queries.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrate 4+ years of experience in indirect tax roles with multinational businesses.
  • Perform indirect tax compliance, GL accounting, and tax advisory for complex, multi-jurisdictional operations.
  • Use tax technology platforms such as Oracle, Avalara, or Zuora.
  • Apply U.S. GAAP accounting principles to tax processes.
  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, with ability to create comprehensive documentation.
  • Maintain high attention to detail and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Bring experience from Big 4 and in-house tax environments.
  • Apply telecommunications industry knowledge to tax operations.

job.description:
What You Can Expect

Workvivo is transforming the way organizations connect, engage, and communicate through Workvivo HQ, Zoom's AI-powered platform designed to drive employee engagement, communication, and culture at scale.

As we scale globally, we're looking for driven individuals to join our Sales Development team. You'll engage directly with senior decision-makers at some of the world's most recognizable organizations, creating pipeline that fuels our growth.

From day one, you'll follow a structured onboarding and ramp plan with dedicated coaching, certification, and continuous development. Whether you have prior sales experience or have excelled in a customer-facing role, we're looking for people who are hardworking, coachable, and hungry to grow.

This is a hybrid role based in Boston, with three days per week in the office

About The Team

Workvivo is a digital platform designed to enhance workplace culture, ensuring employees feel valued, included, and connected regardless of their location.

Dedicated to improving workplace experiences and achieving impactful results, it supports organizations worldwide. Spanning industries like automotive, technology, manufacturing, logistics, and finance, Workvivo transforms employee engagement across diverse sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Generating qualified sales opportunities through professional outreach using phone, email, LinkedIn, and various other channels.
  • Building relationships with senior decision-makers while identifying and exploring new business opportunities.
  • Researching potential customers and conducting discovery discussions to identify their challenges and business priorities.
  • Qualifying opportunities and arranging meetings for Account Executives.
  • Representing the Workvivo brand with professionalism, enthusiasm, and curiosity is essential in every interaction and engagement.
  • Enhancing sales expertise through structured training that integrates onboarding, coaching, accreditation, and ongoing development.

What We’re Looking For

  • Possess experience in a client-facing role where relationships were cultivated effectively and exceptional customer experiences were consistently provided.
  • Exhibit exceptional communication skills when engaging with individuals daily.
  • Comfort with making cold calls and engaging prospective customers through phone, email, LinkedIn and other outreach channels.
  • Demonstrate resilience, and motivation to achieve objectives, with a sincere commitment to learning and ongoing self-improvement.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to embrace feedback while quickly learning new technologies and tools related to sales.
  • Demonstrate enthusiasm to develop and succeed in a lasting career within technology sales.

Approximately 65,000−120,000 OTE annually, based on a standard 40-hour work week. This is a non-exempt position eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable law.

job.description:
What you can expect

We're seeking a senior sales leader to own Zoom's India business and drive its next phase of growth. Reporting to the Head of APAC, you'll lead a high-performing team spanning enterprise, upmarket, mid-market, and SMB segments — with full revenue accountability for one of Zoom's most strategically significant markets.You will shape Zoom's go-to-market strategy for India, build organisational capability, and play a pivotal role in Zoom's broader APAC growth story.

About the Team

The India sales team operates in one of the most dynamic and high-potential markets in the world. Working closely with strategic partners, channel ecosystems, and customers, the team unlocks growth opportunities and positions Zoom as the trusted platform for workplace productivity and customer experience. job.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect

We are hiring a Staff DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer to ensure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence for our real-time communications platform. This platform supports audio/video conferencing, recording, and live-streaming functionalities. The position requires expertise in infrastructure engineering, global team collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.

About the Team

This team manages essential meeting service operations at Zoom. They handle global, large-scale distributed systems and advance communication technology to connect individuals across physical distances.

Responsibilities

Ensuring reliability engineering and operations by owning the SLO/SLI framework for real-time services, defining, tracking, and improving latency, availability, jitter, and packet loss. Leading incident response for critical outages across the real-time platform, coordinating across time zones and engineering disciplines. Promoting a blameless postmortem culture and ensuring action items lead to measurable reliability enhancements. Implementing chaos engineering and game day exercises to proactively identify failure modes before user impact occurs. Building and evolving observability tools — dashboards, alerting systems, and distributed tracing — tailored for real-time media infrastructure challenges. Serving as the architectural authority on deployment patterns, infrastructure design, and operational readiness for real-time services. Reviewing and contributing to system design proposals, providing feedback on scalability, fault tolerance, and operational complexity. Driving capacity planning, traffic modeling, and cost optimization strategies across globally distributed infrastructure. Evaluating and recommending infrastructure tools, platforms, and vendors — including media servers, CDN providers, cloud-native services, and edge networking. Ensuring consistent standards for CI/CD pipelines, deployment safety, and progressive rollout strategies across teams. Acting as the primary SRE partner for multiple engineering teams building real-time features, attending planning sessions, and providing operational readiness guidance. Collaborating closely with network engineering, security, product, and data teams to align on platform-wide reliability requirements. Translating infrastructure constraints and reliability trade-offs into actionable recommendations for product leaders and engineering teams. Establishing and advocating DevOps best practices — infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, automated testing, and deployment automation — across partner teams. Guiding senior engineers on SRE principles, reliability patterns, and operational discipline. Serving as a technical liaison between US-based and China/India-based engineering teams, bridging communication gaps and providing technical context. Conducting architecture reviews, incident retrospectives, and planning sessions in English and Mandarin as appropriate. Maintaining a flexible schedule to ensure meaningful overlap with teams in Beijing, Shanghai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. Building collaborative relationships across cultural and geographic boundaries, adapting communication styles to foster trust and alignment. Ensuring engineering documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records are accessible and understandable for global team members.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles, with at least 3 years at a staff or principal level scope.

  • Have a proven track record owning reliability for large-scale, distributed, latency-sensitive systems in production

  • Have experience in supporting real-time or media-heavy platforms (video conferencing, live streaming, gaming, trading systems, or similar).

  • Demonstrate ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives without direct authority, driving alignment across engineering, product, and operations.

  • Have conceptual and architectural understanding of real-time communication protocols: WebRTC, RTP/RTCP, TURN/STUN, SDP, and SFU/MCU topologies.

  • Have solid expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD).

  • Demonstrate proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tooling: Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent.

job.title: Senior DevOps\SRE Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to ensure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence for our real-time communications platform. This platform supports audio/video conferencing, recording, and live-streaming functionalities. The position requires expertise in infrastructure engineering, global team collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.

About the Team

This team manages essential meeting service operations at Zoom. They handle global, large-scale distributed systems and advance communication technology to connect individuals across physical distances.

Responsibilities

  • Ensuring reliability engineering and operations by owning the SLO/SLI framework for real-time services, defining, tracking, and improving latency, availability, jitter, and packet loss.
  • Leading incident response for critical outages across the real-time platform, coordinating across time zones and engineering disciplines.
  • Promoting a blameless postmortem culture and ensuring action items lead to measurable reliability enhancements.
  • Implementing chaos engineering and game day exercises to proactively identify failure modes before user impact occurs.
  • Building and evolving observability tools — dashboards, alerting systems, and distributed tracing — tailored for real-time media infrastructure challenges.
  • Serving as the architectural authority on deployment patterns, infrastructure design, and operational readiness for real-time services.
  • Reviewing and contributing to system design proposals, providing feedback on scalability, fault tolerance, and operational complexity.
  • Driving capacity planning, traffic modeling, and cost optimization strategies across globally distributed infrastructure.
  • Evaluating and recommending infrastructure tools, platforms, and vendors — including media servers, CDN providers, cloud-native services, and edge networking.
  • Ensuring consistent standards for CI/CD pipelines, deployment safety, and progressive rollout strategies across teams.
  • Acting as the primary SRE partner for multiple engineering teams building real-time features, attending planning sessions, and providing operational readiness guidance.
  • Collaborating closely with network engineering, security, product, and data teams to align on platform-wide reliability requirements.
  • Translating infrastructure constraints and reliability trade-offs into actionable recommendations for product leaders and engineering teams.
  • Establishing and advocating DevOps best practices — infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, automated testing, and deployment automation — across partner teams.
  • Guiding senior engineers on SRE principles, reliability patterns, and operational discipline.
  • Serving as a technical liaison between US-based and China/India-based engineering teams, bridging communication gaps and providing technical context.
  • Conducting architecture reviews, incident retrospectives, and planning sessions in English and Mandarin as appropriate.
  • Maintaining a flexible schedule to ensure meaningful overlap with teams in Beijing, Shanghai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.
  • Building collaborative relationships across cultural and geographic boundaries, adapting communication styles to foster trust and alignment.
  • Ensuring engineering documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records are accessible and understandable for global team members.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles, with at least 3 years at a staff or principal level scope.
  • Have a proven track record owning reliability for large-scale, distributed, latency-sensitive systems in production
  • Have experience in supporting real-time or media-heavy platforms (video conferencing, live streaming, gaming, trading systems, or similar).
  • Demonstrate ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives without direct authority, driving alignment across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Have conceptual and architectural understanding of real-time communication protocols: WebRTC, RTP/RTCP, TURN/STUN, SDP, and SFU/MCU topologies.
  • Have solid expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Demonstrate proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tooling: Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent.
  • Have experience with observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent.
  • Have an understanding of networking fundamentals: BGP, anycast routing, DNS, load balancing, and CDN architecture.
  • Utilize CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Spinnaker to streamline workflows and improve deployment processes.
  • Implement deployment safety practices like canary releases, feature flags, and blue/green strategies to ensure reliable software delivery.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in Ansible scripts, Python, Bash, or Go for automation, tooling, and incident response without requiring advanced software development expertise.
  • On-call rotation participation is required
  • Ability to work across the globe or multiple time zones
  • Mandarin speaker preferred
  • US citizenship preferred

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect


Your ability to quickly learn about the product, business, and technology are your superpowers. You own and execute features independently, build APIs for engineers to solve customer problems, and ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and reliable. You help keep Common Room's core infrastructure ahead of the product's needs, while contributing to key company-building initiatives.


About the Team


Common Room is the AI GTM Platform that empowers teams with AI agents built on complete buyer intelligence. We unify every signal across the full buyer journey into one continuously-updated, person-level view. This allows your team to know exactly who to target and why, what to say, and when to reach out.


GTM teams are navigating tool sprawl, fragmented data, and AI that doesn't deliver. Common Room replaces disconnected stacks with one platform built for scale and complexity. This brings together data, orchestration, and execution in one system built for organizations of 75–1000+.


Responsibilities


  • Developing infrastructure, data models, features, and the overall system to build APIs, and maintain the codebase to resolve customer issues.
  • Writing well-designed, testable code, ensuring systems are efficient, optimized, scalable, and reliable.
  • Developing software testing and validation procedures and documentation.
  • Ensuring Common Room's core internal capabilities, infrastructure, and ML systems serve the needs of customers and our team.
  • Analyzing, problem-solve, and design systems and simple, elegant solutions while considering observability, SLA, and scalability.

What we’re looking for


  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering.
  • Hold a Bachelor's or equivalent experience.
  • Be comfortable working with AWS, Postgres, and Node.js.
  • Able to use TypeGraphQL for our API endpoints, Apollo/Express as our web server, and Postgres(hosted on RDS) + ClickHouse as our database. We use React for front-end, and AWS for our infrastructure needs.
  • Able to take pride in the craft and is excited to own large projects, primarily in the backend domain.
  • Communicate effectively with experienced engineers, including application and front-end engineers.
  • Demonstrate a good judgement on tradeoffs and tooling, avoiding over-indexing on trendy technology — preferring supported, stable solutions.
  • Use customer problems as input into system design, finding joy in creating simple, elegant solutions.

job.title: AI Inference Engineer - Speech
job.description:
What you can expect

We are looking for an AI Inference Engineer with a solid background in speech recognition and model inference. In this role, you will develop state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition system and ship it to various Zoom products. You will work on the most cutting edge speech modeling and inference technologies with world-class speech scientists. This role will include collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product, science engineering teams, and infrastructure teams, to deliver high-impact projects from the ground up.


About the Team

Zoom's AI Speech Team is developing speech recognition technologies to improve Zoom's conversational AI experience. This work impacts various products, like Zoom AI Companion, Zoom Meetings and Workplace, Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Revenue Accelerator, etc. Our team's mission is to equip the powerful AI brain with human-level listening and understanding undefined for voice input.


As an AI Inference Engineer, you will develop novel speech model inference solutions on modern AI inference hardware, such as GPU, TPU and AI-specific chips. Our goal is to deliver the most unique AI-powered collaboration platform to users across the globe.


Responsibilities

  • Developing state-of-the-art speech services for Zoom products. Devising novel techniques where off-the-shelf solutions are not available.
  • Optimizing ASR inference systems for production deployment, including inference latency, throughput, memory footprint, and resource utilization.
  • Optimizing model inference performance by diving deep into the lower stack of inference frameworks, with a focus on hardware-specific optimizations for Nvidia GPUs.
  • Proposing new model structures by joint optimization of model accuracy and inference speed.
  • Designing and developing ASR systems with low latency and high accuracy requirements, while ensuring scalability of GPU infrastructure and improving throughput of ASR service.
  • Profiling and debugging ASR runtime performance bottlenecks across different deployment hardware and environments.

What we’re looking for

  • Possess a Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields with 3+ years of experience in speech recognition, speech-llm or AI model inference.
  • Display knowledge in deep learning and hands-on programming skills in Python, shell scripts, C/C++; familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.
  • Demonstrate deep understanding of transformer encoder-decoder frameworks for speech recognition, including attention mechanisms, beam search and sequence-to-sequence modeling for end-to-end ASR systems.
  • Understand recent advancements in speech foundation models and speech-LLMs that integrate acoustic and linguistic representations, enabling unified modeling for speech understanding and transcription tasks.
  • Have experience in optimizing deep learning model inference on NVIDIA GPUs, including profiling and accelerating AI models using CUDA, TensorRT, and mixed-precision computation to achieve low latency, high-throughput performance.
  • Have experience developing and tuning custom CUDA kernels, leveraging CUDA Graphs for efficient execution scheduling, and minimizing kernel launch overhead to maximize GPU utilization.
  • Be proficient in end-to-end performance analysis, memory optimization, and deployment of largescale ML models on GPU clusters. Experienced with stream management, asynchronous execution, and integrating frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow for real-time inference.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

Design, build, and own the data pipelines, models, and products that power sales, customer success, and revenue analytics for Zoom's Go-To-Market organization. Partner with business and finance teams to build data systems that power both human analysts and AI agents. Build and ship data products end-to-end using AI-powered tools with full autonomy over the pipeline.

About the Team

We build the data foundations that power Zoom's revenue operations. Our team partners across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Engineering to deliver trusted, scalable data products for both business stakeholders and AI-driven workflows. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to making data accessible and actionable for every team we support.

Responsibilities

  • Acting as the technical lead/primary engineer for Go-To-Market, Revenue Operations, and Sales translating complex business problems, including forecasting, attribution, and churn, into production-grade data products.

  • Treating AI as core engineering multiplier: use agentic tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for rapid prototyping, architecture design, refactoring, and code review. Build LLM-assisted workflows such as automated schema mapping and natural-language query layers.

  • Designing and build data models (Kimball, Data Vault), scalable pipelines that ingest and transform Go-To-Market data from Salesforce, product usage, billing, and customer success systems.

  • Building unified semantic layers and data marts that connect diverse source systems. Establish data contracts, schema governance, and lineage standards to ensure reliable downstream consumption.

  • Balancing real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, event-driven pipelines) with modern batch warehouse patterns, working across Snowflake/Databricks, DBT, Fivetran, and Airflow.

  • Applying software engineering discipline CI/CD, automated testing, version control to build data quality, observability, and monitoring frameworks; mentor peers, contribute to documentation and governance reviews.

What we’re looking for

  • Have a Bachelor's in Computer Science or Software Engineering. Brings 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data architecture, or forward-deployed engineering and a track record of shipping production-grade data systems.

  • Have expert proficiency in Python and advanced SQL, hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses or lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks), transformation tooling (dbt), and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster).

  • Demonstrate excellent background in data modeling methodologies (Kimball, Data Vault, dimensional modeling, semantic layer design) applied to complex enterprise domains. Ideally revenue operations or Go-To-Market contexts such as Salesforce, marketing automation, or product telemetry.

  • Demonstrate use of AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and agentic workflows as an integrated part of daily engineering. Not just experimentation along with genuine interest in embedding LLMs into data workflows (text-to-SQL, automated cataloging, generative data quality testing).

  • Work knowledge of real-time event streaming and ingestion architectures (Kafka, event buses, webhooks), familiarity with modern software practices including CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and test-driven development.

  • Have a forward-deployed mindset consultative, resilient in ambiguity, and focused on user impact and delivery speed. With the ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders while maintaining credibility with engineering teams.

Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues for Zoom's Elite customers. You'll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams using advanced troubleshooting tools. Your work directly protects customer experience on Zoom's platform.

About the Team

We support Elite customers across the full spectrum of UC challenges. Our team owns issues end-to-end, collaborating across engineering and services. We exist to keep Zoom's most critical customers running.

Note: The role will be based out of Hyderabad

  • Owning end-to-end technical support for assigned Elite customers, from issue diagnosis through resolution and ticket closure.

job.title: Scale Campaigns & ABM Manager - Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is investing in a scaled account based marketing motion and is seeking someone to own it end to end. This role connects marketing, SDR, and sales teams. The position involves transforming account insights into actionable strategies by identifying accounts, building data foundations, and collaborating with SDR and AE teams.

It requires expertise in guiding SDR and AE leaders on account prioritization. Candidates with experience managing tiered strategies and distinguishing between activity and pipeline will thrive in this role. The focus is on delivering impactful and timely initiatives that drive success across targeted accounts.

About the Team

This role is part of the Global Field and Strategic Events team within Growth and Demand Generation. It focuses on account-based marketing strategies. Responsibilities include executing personalized programs for top US accounts, targeted programs for account clusters, and broader initiatives combining events, digital, and field efforts.

The target audience includes enterprise leaders such as CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications professionals. The role emphasizes creating impactful marketing motions to engage key stakeholders and scale efforts effectively across various segments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Workvivo’s tiered ABM motion involves 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account clusters, and 1:many for programmatic engagement at scale.

  • Building and maintaining the account scoring and intent framework determines the appropriate tier placement and timing for account transitions.

  • Designing and managing multi-channel campaigns that integrate outbound, paid, and content efforts, ensuring accounts experience a unified approach rather than fragmented interactions.

  • Collaborating directly with SDR leaders to convert account priorities into structured sequencing, cadence, and outreach strategies.

  • Partnering directly with AE teams on account planning, defining shared transfer criteria, and ensuring joint accountability for pipeline within target accounts.

  • Managing the enrichment and intent data stack while overseeing associated vendor relationships.

  • Reporting on ABM performance involves using account-level metrics like engagement, penetration, and pipeline influenced, rather than focusing solely on activity volume.

  • Collaborating with Marketing Ops and RevOps ensures accurate account and contact data, as scaled processes quickly fail when the information is incorrect. Adapting the motion by region, recognizing that EMEA, LATAM, and APJ will not run the same play at the same pace.

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrate experience using an intent or account scoring platform such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar within a production environment.

  • Demonstrate experience with enrichment and data orchestration tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or similar) and how to connect them cleanly into a CRM.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Salesforce and a sequencing tool like Outreach, including understanding how account and contact data transfers between platforms.

  • Demonstrate over six years of experience developing and managing tiered account-based marketing strategies effectively.

  • Direct experience as an SDR or working alongside SDR and AE teams on the same accounts, with shared ownership of outcomes.

  • Comfort presenting account level and pipeline metrics to stakeholders in clear, accessible language.

  • Operate effectively across various regions or markets.

  • Develop an ABM function from an initial or unstructured phase into a well-organized, tiered approach.

  • Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology within an organization utilizing a distributed or hybrid sales structure.

job.title: Staff AI Engineer - AI Verticals
job.description:
What you can expect

As an AI Engineer specializing in Agentic AI, you will develop intelligent agents that can autonomously perceive, reason, and act in dynamic environments as part of Zoom AI Companion (AIC).

Your work will directly impact the Zoom user experience by designing and implementing innovative algorithms and systems. These enhancements will improve workplace efficiency and customer engagement across Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA), Zoom Customer Experience (ZCX) and Zoom Workplace, serving vertical domains like healthcare, education, banking, and insurance.


 

About the Team

We are part of the Zoom AI Vertical Organization, dedicated to enhancing the Zoom user experience in workplace and customer interactions. Our team of innovative thinkers is focused on creating the next generation of AI technologies that can autonomously understand, learn, and adapt to improve user engagement and satisfaction. We are seeking an AI engineer to join our team and contribute to our groundbreaking Agentic AI project.


 

Responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing backend orchestration layers between AI components within microservices, focusing on agent workflows and runtime operations.

  • Building scalable LLM-powered systems including RAG pipelines, tool-use workflows, and multi-step reasoning agents.

  • Building AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, Dify, OpenAI SDK or internal orchestration system through code (not no-code tools), ensuring proper agent flow implementation.

  • Developing integration between various AI components including LLM, RAG, TTS (Text-to-Speech), and ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) systems.

  • Writing and optimizing prompts for AI agents, conduct integration testing, and ensure proper functionality of agent systems.

  • Collaborating with research and product engineering teams to implement agent-based solutions that enhance user experience across vertical domains.

What we’re looking for

  • Possess a Bachelor's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cognitive Science or related field, and 10+ years industry experience (or a Master's and 8+ years, or a PhD + 5 years).

  • Show an understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, reinforcement learning, cognitive architectures, and multi-modality including speech and vision.

  • Exhibit development skills in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java, and experience with AI frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch).

  • Have familiarity with Multiple Agent architectures and experience in designing and implementing multi-agent systems.

  • Utilize problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively and critically about complex problems.

  • Communicate and collaborate with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

job.title: Data Center Support Technician
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect​

In this dynamic, hands-on environment, you’ll troubleshoot complex systems, work on diverse infrastructure projects, and continuously grow your technical expertise in a dynamic setting.

About the Team

You’ll join a collaborative and highly skilled group of engineers who are passionate about maintaining reliable data center operations. All while supporting each other to deliver exceptional results.

Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and carrying out tasks through JIRA ticketing system. While understanding process for diagnostic methods of troubleshooting data center infrastructure.

  • Supporting Network Engineering, SysAdmin, and Project Management team to perform required work within the data center environment

  • Managing hardware asset tags, perform quarterly and year-end audit with Finance Team. Repairing servers (replace hard drives; replace faulty SIM, Fiber SFP, cabling, etc.)

  • Partnering with Telco Provisioning to process and track cross connect orders, validate LOA/CFA, onsite support during circuit test & turn-up.

  • On-location support implementation of hardware and infrastructure as directed for special projects. Producing periodic status reports on utilization, progress, downtime, performance and costs.

  • Managing spare part inventory including packaging and shipping parts to remote data center locations. While Self-performing server diagnostic and troubleshooting.

  • Being responsible for up keeping of the data center environment. This includes ensuring all guests while working in the data center operates within the published operating procedure and guidelines.

What we’re looking for

  • 2-3 years experienced in related field or certificate or degree programs such as Industrial Technology, Computer Electronics and Networking Technology, Information Technology.

  • Understand Network Fundamentals and computer hardware troubleshooting skills

  • Bring previous experience with datacenter equipment including console, KVM, and power control. With familiarity with JIRA ticketing system.

  • Have customer-focused mindset, with demonstrated skill in managing expectations, providing proactive status updates, and producing high-quality work product.

job.title: Head of Post Sales - Common Room
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will lead the entire post-sale customer organization, owning outcomes across a large, complex ARR portfolio that includes our highest-value Enterprise accounts. Reporting to the Head of Revenue, you will be accountable for retention, expansion, and transforming Customer Success into a measurable revenue engine. This is a role where you will shape how we deliver value to customers, from implementation through renewal and growth, while building and scaling the teams and systems that make it all work. You will bring operational rigor, a growth mindset, and a genuine curiosity for deploying AI-enabled tools to scale customer engagement without scaling headcount proportionally.


About the Team

Our Post Sales organization spans Customer Success, Support, Implementation, and Account Management, and works at the intersection of customer value and revenue growth. We collaborate across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to amplify the customer voice and turn insights into measurable business outcomes. Together, we are building the operating model for how modern companies retain and expand their most important relationships.


Responsibilities

  • You will own customer outcomes across the full portfolio, including direct strategic oversight of the Enterprise segment and executive sponsorship of top-tier accounts.
  • You will drive Gross Revenue Retention improvement across Enterprise and broader customer segments through proactive risk management, health scoring, and renewal strategy.
  • You will build and scale a Customer Success-sourced pipeline motion, turning post-sale engagement into a quantifiable growth contributor connected to expansion revenue.
  • You will lead and develop a team of managers and individual contributors across Success, Support, Implementation, and Account Management, promoting from within and expanding coverage as the business grows.
  • You will design and implement a unified customer operating model with common health scoring, risk identification, renewal readiness, and growth frameworks across the full customer lifecycle.
  • You will identify and deploy AI-enabled tools (support automation, self-service, knowledge delivery) to increase organizational scale while preserving high-touch engagement for strategic accounts.
  • You will build a company-wide Voice of Customer feedback loop connecting Customer Success, Product, Revenue, and Executive Leadership to inform roadmap and account strategy.
  • You will own budget planning, technology investment, workforce planning, and capacity modeling, along with executive reporting frameworks that improve visibility into health, risk, adoption, and forecast accuracy.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Growth, or related revenue leadership roles within B2B SaaS, with demonstrated people-management experience at scale.
  • Proven experience owning a large (8-figure or greater) ARR portfolio, including Enterprise accounts with Fortune 500 customers.
  • Track record of measurably improving Gross Revenue Retention and building Customer Success into a pipeline-generating function.
  • Experience designing and operating unified customer lifecycle models, including health scoring, risk management, renewal strategy, and expansion frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of modern CS and RevOps tooling (for example, Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Gong, HubSpot, or similar platforms).
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI and automation to scale support and customer engagement functions.
  • Experience with budget ownership, workforce planning, and capacity modeling across customer-facing organizations.

job.title: Product Marketing Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation. You will shape how small and medium-sized businesses, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams discover and understand the Zoom AI Productivity Suite. You will personally take ideas from product insight through scripting, recording, editing, publishing, and measurement. This is an opportunity to build a content and distribution system from the ground up and see how your work contributes directly to product growth.


About the Team


The Zoom AI Productivity Suite team is building a new AI-native way to work, helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables they can act on. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We are a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities

  • Develop deep, working knowledge of the Zoom AI Productivity Suite, including who uses it, what problems it solves for small and medium-sized businesses and independent creators, how it compares to alternatives, and where its real advantages lie
  • Define and maintain positioning and messaging that starts with the user problem, not the feature list, and translates product capabilities into clear, specific, outcome-oriented value
  • Own the end-to-end creation and publication of product content, including short-form demos, screen recordings, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy, from initial concept through measurement, without depending on an agency or production team
  • Use AI tools fluently across the full content workflow, including research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, editing, and rapid iteration, to move quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Build a repeatable content and distribution engine from the ground up to drive PLG strategy and take ownership of business growth targets, making independent prioritization calls and driving execution without waiting for a fully developed brief or established process
  • Plan and distribute platform-native content across X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram Reels, matching format and depth to the expectations of each audience and the stage of the funnel
  • Identify and engage with third-party platforms, software-review sites, benchmark leaderboards, and vertical communities to build product credibility, drive discovery, run user operations and generate trial
  • Track what is working using engagement quality, trial, subscription, and adoption signals, then use those findings to improve product stories, content formats, and calls to action
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing partners to keep product stories accurate and move content at the pace of product development


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, social content, with a focus on digital products such as SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products, or equivalent experience
  • Strong product instincts: the ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine product differentiators, and turn those insights into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible, particularly for small and medium-sized business audiences, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams
  • Hands-on fluency using AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration, not just familiarity with the tools but practical comfort shipping work with them
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish work end-to-end, including short-form product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content created to market and explain digital products
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution dynamics differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn, with demonstrated depth on at least some of these platforms
  • A track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, a product launch, or a distribution system, and driving it forward through ambiguity without waiting for established processes. Candidates who have built and grown their own relevant content channels with measurable results are also encouraged to apply
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred, though not required if the work itself demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability

job.title: Employee Relations Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own Zoom's employee relations function end to end, from leading complex workplace investigations to building the manager enablement programs that prevent issues before they escalate. You will serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and People Business Partners across all US locations, bringing both legal grounding and sound judgment to the most sensitive situations the organization faces. Day to day, the work spans performance documentation, investigation management, compliance training design, and systemic trend analysis, all in service of building a workplace where employees and teams can do their best work.

About the Team

Our People team delivers strategic HR solutions that enable business performance and employee growth, partnering closely across People Business Partners, Legal, and business leaders to navigate the organization's most complex challenges. We exist to build trust, ensure compliance, and create the conditions where people and teams can thrive at scale. Our work sits at the intersection of compliance, culture, and care.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end workplace investigations across all US jurisdictions, partnering with Legal and People Business Partners to assess risk, document findings, and drive resolution.

  • Manage the Performance Improvement Plan lifecycle, ensuring documentation quality, timeline adherence, and consistent application across the organization.

  • Coach managers on performance documentation, difficult conversations, and accountability practices that prevent escalation and support employee development.

  • Design and deliver manager enablement programs on feedback, performance management, hiring practices, and compliance topics.

  • Analyze employee relations trends, exit data, and survey feedback to identify systemic issues and recommend data-driven interventions to leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of employee relations experience, including leading complex workplace investigations involving multiple stakeholders and senior employees.

  • Deep knowledge of California employment law and multi-state US compliance requirements, with demonstrated ability to apply legal insight to risk assessment and organizational decision-making.

  • Proven track record of coaching managers through performance documentation, difficult conversations, and accountability processes, including providing real-time guidance during active performance situations.

  • Precision in documenting investigations, case resolutions, and performance actions with the detail and consistency required to withstand legal scrutiny.

  • Experience navigating difficult conversations with senior leaders and employees while remaining objective, grounded, and solution-focused.

  • Background building scalable employee relations processes, compliance training programs, and documentation systems in high-growth or evolving environments.

  • SHRM-CP, PHR, or employment law certification; experience in technology or SaaS companies with distributed workforces preferred.

job.title: Lead Product Manager, Revenue OS Platform Commercialization
job.description:
What you can expect

As Lead Product Manager for Revenue OS Platform Commercialization, you'll shape how Revenue OS evolves from a powerful application suite into an extensible platform that customers, developers, and AI agents can build on and transact with. You'll own the data foundations, APIs, integrations, and headless capabilities at the core of this transformation, working at the intersection of platform architecture, AI orchestration, and commercial strategy. Partnering with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, and Go-To-Market, you'll turn complex orchestration challenges into simple, trusted products with measurable business impact. This is a high-visibility role where your platform decisions shape an emerging revenue category for Zoom.

About the Team

We build the AI layer powering Zoom's revenue products. Our team spans engineering, design, and go-to-market, working together to ship intelligent workflows that turn AI capability into measurable customer value. We operate at the frontier of what's possible, balancing speed and craft to deliver platform foundations that scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and ship the headless Revenue OS strategy, including APIs, MCP protocols, and agent-facing capabilities, establishing how capabilities are packaged, discovered, and monetized.

  • Own the revenue data foundation across identity, object models, relationships, permissions, and data quality, partnering with engineering to connect people, accounts, opportunities, activities, and outcomes.

  • Build an integration and extensibility platform that connects Revenue OS to CRM, communication systems, data warehouses, and ecosystem partners through a scalable, standards-based model.

  • Define the primitives, context, and actions that enable internal and external AI agents to reason over revenue data and safely execute work across systems.

  • Drive the vision and roadmap for agentic orchestration, translating evolving AI capabilities into a clear, durable product strategy aligned with commercial outcomes.

  • Partner with Engineering, AI/ML, and Design on orchestration architecture, reasoning systems, tool use, reliability, and human-in-the-loop design to make sophisticated systems feel simple and controllable.

  • Own the full product path from insight through launch, adoption, packaging, and commercialization, working closely with Go-To-Market partners.

  • Create an excellent developer and partner experience, from authentication and documentation to observability, governance, and lifecycle management.

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent field, or equivalent experience, with 8-10 years of proven product management experience at Lead PM scope, including delivery of complex zero-to-one products.

  • Solid experience building AI-native products, agents, orchestration systems, or intelligent workflows.

  • Strong product sense and UX judgment applied to technically complex systems, with a track record of making sophisticated capabilities feel simple and trustworthy to end users.

  • Deep understanding of agentic systems including context management, reasoning, orchestration, tool use, evaluation, permissions, and human oversight, combined with technical fluency to partner credibly with senior Engineering and AI/ML teams.

  • Commercial instincts around differentiation, adoption, packaging, and monetization, with the ability to translate deeply ambiguous technical possibilities into clear product strategy and elegant customer experiences.

  • Background in enterprise SaaS, revenue technology, CRM, or workflow automation is a strong plus.

job.title: Account Executive - State & Local Government
job.description:
About the Role

The Zoom Public Sector Team seeks an Account Executive to sell the Zoom Workplace platform to State & Local Government accounts in Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana and Arkansas. This is a consultative, strategic selling role focused on AI initiatives and digital transformation.

In this role, you will engage with state CIOs, executive directors, IT and key Line of Business Leaders to help them modernize communication and collaboration with Zoom's AI-powered solutions.

Key to your success at Zoom will be strong prospecting and pipeline development, strategic account and territory management, and well-honed presentation skills. Understanding how to sell with and through the Channel is also important.

At Zoom, Enterprise Selling is a team effort - as a Public Sector Account Executive you will align, organize, influence and collaborate with your Zoom team mates - Solutions Engineers, Technology Specialists, Customer Success Managers and Specialist Engineers in service of your business, and our Customers. You will also collaborate, orchestrate and enable with our key Channel Partners to drive thought leadership and Enterprise sales cycle motions.

About the Team

As part of Zoom's Public Sector Sales team, you will expand our presence across State and Local Government Agencies and Entities. You will advocate the innovative power of our platform to make organizations more productive, collaborative, and mobile in the pursuit of delivering positive outcomes to their Constituents.

Responsibilities

  • Acquiring and growing State & Local Government accounts across Your Region; discovering and articulating key Use Cases that drive interest in Zoom and outcomes for our Customers

  • Leading with AI and digital transformation conversations—position Zoom's federated AI model and Workplace platform as strategic enablers for government modernization

  • Selling consultatively to key Government Personas

  • Selling Zoom Workplace with emphasis on AI, Cloud Voice and Contact Center

  • Building trusted relationships with executives, line of business decision makers, and IT leaders in state and local government agencies

  • Orchestrating and delivering thoughtful demonstrations, proposals, negotiations, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that emphasize Zoom's capabilities and business outcomes

  • Navigating complex government procurement processes and long public sector sales cycles

  • Partnering with channel organizations to expand reach and accelerate adoption

  • Working strategically with management to deliver forecasts, identify trending opportunities/challenges, and provide recommended solutions

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of Account Executive experience with consistent quota achievement

  • Experience selling to State & Local Government

  • Experience with AI and SaaS sales with a track record of consultative, solution-oriented selling

  • Consultative selling approach with ability to engage C-level executives on strategic initiatives

  • Experience managing and operating within government procurement and contracting cycles

  • Reside in Texas. This is a remote position in Texas

job.description:
Workplace Coordinator, Customer Engagement

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will serve as the face of Zoom’s Tokyo office, creating meaningful experiences for customers, employees, and visitors at one of our most important customer-facing sites in the region. You will lead day-to-day operations while supporting high-impact customer events and Experience Center programming, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Zoom’s standard for world-class service. Beyond office management, you will play an active part in the planning and execution of Zoom’s new Tokyo office relocation, collaborating with contractors, internal stakeholders, and a global Real Estate and Workplace Services team spanning markets from Singapore to San Jose. Full professional fluency in Japanese and English is required for this role. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our Tokyo, Japan office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Real Estate and Workplace Services team at Zoom drives the physical environments and workplace experiences that enable Zoom’s global workforce to do their best work. Operating across major offices in the Asia Pacific region and beyond, this team ensures every Zoom location is a welcoming, functional, and connected space for Zoomies and customers alike. As a member of the Tokyo team, you will contribute to a growing APAC presence with close ties to counterparts in Singapore, Sydney, Mumbai, and the broader global organization.

Responsibilities

  • Operate the Tokyo office end-to-end, managing facilities, vendor relationships, preventative maintenance, badge access, shipping and receiving, and catering coordination to maintain a safe, welcoming environment for all employees and guests.
  • Lead on-site health and safety protocols, including emergency procedures and evacuation planning, as an active member of Zoom’s local health and safety team.
  • Deliver exceptional customer and visitor experiences by welcoming guests, pre-registering attendees, and serving as the primary on-site point of contact during all customer visits and Experience Center events.
  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of customer-facing and internal events, covering room setup, AV readiness, catering logistics, and post-event wrap-up.
  • Manage virtual reception across the APAC region and collaborate with regional Workplace Coordinators in Singapore, Sydney, and Mumbai to align on standards, share best practices, and support cross-regional initiatives.
  • Coordinate Zoom’s Tokyo office relocation by serving as the on-the-ground liaison for construction and fit-out activities, tracking milestones, flagging issues, managing FF&E procurement, and supporting Day 1 readiness planning.
  • Partner with administrative and onboarding teams to support new hire workspace setup, badge issuance, office orientation, vendor contract records, purchase order tracking, and budget reporting.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2 or more years of experience in workplace coordination, office management, facilities, events, or an executive briefing or customer engagement environment, with a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality employee and customer experiences.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating customer-facing events, VIP visits, or executive programming, with strong attention to logistics, setup, and real-time problem-solving.
  • Stakeholder and vendor management experience, including familiarity with preventative maintenance processes and health and safety protocols.
  • Experience with internal facility ticketing systems and a proven ability to manage workloads within established SLAs; office relocation or build-out experience is a plus.
  • Organized, self-directed approach to work with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive projects to completion with minimal direction.
  • Full professional fluency in Japanese and English (written and spoken) is required.
  • Proficiency in workplace tools including the Zoom Workplace platform, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, and facility management systems.

job.title: Lead Technical SEO Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.


About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

job.title: Audio AI Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

As an Audio AI Engineer, you will research and develop algorithms for accent conversion, voice conversion, speech synthesis, and speech recognition on low-latency streaming architectures. You’ll prototype and refine end-to-end audio models that enhance intelligibility and naturalness while maintaining speaker identity. Working closely with product and platform teams, you’ll help bring these models into real-time communication systems. You will also evaluate and optimize model performance across dimensions such as quality, latency, and scalability. Staying current with advances in speech processing, you’ll contribute to innovation through patents and internal knowledge sharing.

About the Team

Zoom's Audio team develops real-time audio features based on AI algorithms. Members of the team are spread worldwide, including the U.S., China and Singapore.

Responsibilities

  • Researching, designing, and developing algorithms for accent conversion, voice conversion, speech synthesis, and automatic speech recognition, focusing on low-latency streaming architectures.

  • Prototyping end-to-end audio models that enhance intelligibility and naturalness while preserving speaker identity and expressiveness.

  • Collaborating closely with product and platform teams to integrate models into real-time video and audio communication systems.

  • Analyzing and optimizing model performance across speech quality, latency, robustness, and scalability dimensions.

  • Staying current with the latest developments in speech processing research, and contribute to the community through patents, and internal knowledge sharing.

What we’re looking for

  • Hold a PhD or equivalent experience in a relevant field in Streaming, Accent Conversion, Voice Conversion, TTS, or ASR. More than 2 years of relevant industry experience considered a plus.

  • Show proficiency in deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Demonstrate effective programming skills in Python, C/C++, or similar languages.

  • Have an understanding of sequence modeling architectures (Transformers, RNNs, diffusion models, or conformers).

  • Demonstrate experience developing and deploying low-latency, real-time speech or audio models with streaming architectures and optimized pipelines.

  • Show familiarity with model compression and acceleration techniques, including quantization, pruning, and distillation.

  • Exhibit experience working with real-time audio systems in networked communication environments.

  • Publish in top-tier conferences such as Icassp, Interspeech, NeurIPS, and ICLR.
