job.title: Zoom Onboarding Specialist
job.description:
Zoom Onboarding Specialist

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own the end-to-end onboarding experience for newly contracted customers in Japan, guiding them from kickoff through to a confident handoff to the Customer Success team. You will deliver live administrator and end-user training sessions independently, working directly with customers to drive successful adoption of Zoom Workplace, Zoom Phone, and Zoom Revenue Accelerator. Native-level Japanese fluency and the ability to create and localize training materials from English source content are required for this role. You will report to the US-based Zoom Onboarding Specialist (ZOS) manager and serve as the primary Japan market voice, sharing customer insights and shaping local onboarding processes.

About the Team

The Zoom Onboarding Specialist team sits within the Customer Success organization and plays a meaningful role in how customers experience Zoom from day one. We partner closely with CSMs, CSAs, Sales, and Renewals teams across Japan and globally to ensure every customer gets the foundation they need to grow and thrive. Our work directly influences product adoption, customer retention, and the long-term success of Zoom’s enterprise relationships.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver live customer training sessions, including administrator training, end-user training, and power-pack sessions, independently and with confidence.
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding journey for newly contracted accounts: kickoff coordination, configuration guidance, training delivery, and handoff to CSM/CSA.
  • Create and localize training materials by translating and adapting global English-language resources, including slide decks, guides, and FAQs, into Japanese.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CSM, CSA, Renewals, and Sales teams in Japan to ensure seamless customer handoffs and aligned onboarding strategies.
  • Analyze customer onboarding trends and provide actionable feedback to internal stakeholders to uphold quality standards and address evolving product and customer requirements.
  • Communicate proactively with global ZOS leadership, sharing Japan market insights, customer feedback, and proposed process improvements to shape Japan-specific onboarding practices.
  • Partner with Customer Success leadership on an ongoing basis to surface onboarding successes, risks, and areas of opportunity.


What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience delivering live, customer-facing training sessions independently, including facilitation, Q&A management, and session ownership from start to finish.
  • Native-level Japanese fluency, written and spoken, combined with strong English reading comprehension to interpret and localize global source materials.
  • Ability to create and adapt customer-facing training resources, including slide decks, guides, and FAQs, for a Japanese-speaking audience.
  • Experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Support, or Presales Engineering, or equivalent experience, with a SaaS or UCaaS product context preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate with high autonomy while staying aligned with a globally distributed team across time zones.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to present to executive and key decision-maker audiences when required.
  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with the adaptability to thrive in environments where processes, products, and team structures evolve continuously.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

You will engineer and operate Zoom's global corporate network across campus, cloud, and remote environments. You will automate repetitive work and improve observability to keep the network reliable at scale. Your efforts directly support Zoom's product teams and AI initiatives.

About the Team

IT Network Engineering owns the infrastructure connecting Zoom's global workforce. We automate aggressively and build reliable tooling. We fix things properly — once.

Responsibilities:

  • Operating enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure including switching, routing, wireless, and SD-WAN across global sites.

  • Administering firewall policies, Zero Trust remote access, and 802.1X network access control for secure connectivity.

  • Supporting cloud network connectivity and partnering with Security and Cloud Engineering teams on cross-functional projects.

  • Building automation scripts, playbooks, and Infrastructure-as-Code templates to reduce operational toil.

  • Maintaining runbooks, network diagrams, and change procedures to ensure operational clarity and knowledge sharing.

What we’re looking for

  • Have 5+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience spanning LAN, WAN, and wireless environments.

  • Demonstrate strong TCP/IP fundamentals and packet-level troubleshooting skills (Layer 2 through Layer 4).

  • Operate firewalls (Palo Alto or equivalent) and Zero Trust platforms (Zscaler, Prisma Access, or equivalent).

  • Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X / NAC in an enterprise environment.

  • Manage Juniper (EX, QFX, SRX, MX) or equivalent routing and switching platforms.

  • Monitor networks using SNMP, NetFlow, syslog, or equivalent observability tooling.

Ways of Working

job.title: Manager, Lifecycle & Email Marketing
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle and email marketing function for Workvivo by Zoom, the AI-native employee experience platform trusted by over 10 million users across leading global enterprises. You will set the strategy for how prospects move from first interaction to qualified sales conversation, build and run the programmes that make that happen, and be directly measured on pipeline contribution. Working closely with regional demand generation, SDR managers, revenue operations, and product marketing, you will serve as the connective tissue between every channel investment and the pipeline it generates. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Dublin, Ireland office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Workvivo growth team runs demand generation, campaigns, and SDR programmes across every major region, including North America, EMEA, LATAM, and APJ. Lifecycle and email sit at the centre of that motion, serving as the mechanism through which every channel investment either converts to pipeline or stalls. Our team operates with full ownership of strategy and delivery, partnering closely with sales and revenue operations to move fast and show measurable results.


Responsibilities

  • Own the global email programme end to end, including nurture, product and content sends, event follow-up, database re-engagement, and win-back campaigns
  • Build and send all campaign emails: construct templates, shape copy, define and segment audiences, configure workflows, and ship to deadlines without hand-off
  • Design, launch, and maintain all nurture programmes covering inbound follow-up, content and event follow-up, stalled lead re-engagement, and SDR nurture in partnership with regional SDR managers
  • Define and maintain the lifecycle stage model from first touch through to sales accepted opportunity, working with revenue operations to keep every region aligned to one definition
  • Own audience selection, send governance, contact frequency, and overlap management across regional and global sends to protect deliverability and sender reputation
  • Lead the content syndication channel: set offer and asset strategy, define lead acceptance criteria, own the nurture behind every syndication programme, and hold the channel to a pipeline conversion standard
  • Grow the marketable database by region and in local language, including Spanish (LATAM), Portuguese (Brazil), and other priority markets per Workvivo’s localisation framework, and report performance in revenue terms across conversion by stage, velocity, and cost per qualified opportunity

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience owning email and nurture in a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of designing programmes from the ground up and measuring their impact on conversion, or equivalent experience
  • Deep, hands-on marketing automation capability in HubSpot and Salesforce, or in comparable platforms such as Marketo, Braze, or Eloqua, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated ability to build and ship email independently: template construction, list building, workflow setup, QA across clients, and delivery to deadline
  • Strong judgement across deliverability, segmentation, list hygiene, and testing disciplines, with comfort interrogating funnel data and building self-serve reporting
  • Experience running a paid lead source such as content syndication, with a clear point of view on how to make cold-acquired names convert to pipeline
  • Experience working across multiple regions and languages, and the ability to build and manage programmes that run natively in more than one language
  • Ability to work closely with sales and SDR teams and to present performance and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders using data

job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect

We are seeking a talented engineer to join our AI Agent Experience team to help build the next-generation intelligent collaboration platform. Our team focuses on the experiential layer of multimodal AI Agent capabilities, deeply integrated into the Zoom Workplace ecosystem. As well as redefining meetings, communication, and collaboration through Agents.

About the Team

You will play a key technical role, leading core architecture design and tackling complex systems, collaborating with top engineers globally to define AI-driven future work methods.

Responsibilities:  

  • Architect and develop core AI Agent functionalities using Python and Java, ensuring high-performance, fault-tolerant, and high-availability backend systems that are deeply integrated into Zoom’s global platform;
  • Design and implement distributed system components and APIs supporting multimodal AI Agents that handle real-time communication, meeting automation, and intelligent task management;
  • Lead cross-functional engineering initiatives by collaborating with product managers, designers, and AI researchers to integrate large language model (LLM)–based capabilities into enterprise collaboration workflows;
  • Analyze complex technical requirements and propose scalable design solutions aligned with Zoom’s architectural standards and data security protocols;
  • Mentor global engineering teams, sharing specialized expertise in distributed system optimization, database design (MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka), and microservice deployment (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Drive system innovation by identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, enabling continuous optimization across largescale, cloud-native environments;
  • Ensure alignment between AI feature development and enterprise product strategy, contributing to architecture design reviews and technical roadmaps for AI Agent Experience products; and
  • Facilitate cross-border collaboration between global R&D centers, coordinating with engineering teams in North America and Asia to ensure consistent standards, integration, and delivery of AI-driven collaboration tools.

What we're looking for:

Requires a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or a foreign equivalent. Must have 3 years of experience in job offered or related occupation. Must have 3 years of experience in the following:

  • 3 years of experience In-depth understanding of AI Agent architecture, including distributed system design and integration with front-end and AI model services;
  • 3 years of experience with Advanced proficiency in Python and Java backend systems, including experience with microservices, API frameworks, and data orchestration pipelines;
  • 3 years of experience with Strong background in database optimization (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch);
  • 3 years of expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes for large-scale deployments;
  • 3 years of experience and familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to enhance engineering efficiency; and

job.title: Sales Development Manager, Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is the employee communications platform trusted by some of the world's most recognisable brands, now scaling globally as part of Zoom. We connect millions of employees to their companies' culture, leadership and purpose and our Sales Development org is a critical engine of that growth.

We're hiring a Sales Development Manager to lead our EMEA & APJ Sales Development team. You'll manage a team of SDRs across the region, reporting directly to the Head of Sales Development. You'll be responsible for turning strategy into execution — driving pipeline performance, developing your team, building a strong coaching culture and ensuring our EMEA & APJ SDR motion operates with pace, consistency and discipline.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who coaches in the trenches, knows how to develop SDR talent and can create the environment where people consistently perform at their best.


About the team

Workvivo operates at the intersection of employee communications and employee insights, serving mid-market and enterprise companies globally. Our buyers are CHROs, CTOs, CIOs and Internal Comms Directors — a senior, multi-stakeholder profile that rewards insight-led, persona-aware outreach over high-volume spray approaches.

This is a genuinely exciting moment to join. Workvivo recently launched Seer, our employee insights solution, bringing listening, analytics and action into a single platform alongside our communications product. And with Workvivo HQ — our AI-native employee experience platform — now in market, we have a compelling, expanded story to take to enterprise buyers. Two strong products, a rapidly expanding global footprint, and the backing of Zoom's worldwide network: the opportunity to build pipeline at scale and make a material impact on Workvivo's next chapter of growth has never been greater.

The EMEA & APJ SDR team operates a balanced motion: structured outbound sequencing into target accounts alongside managed inbound response. You'll be responsible for ensuring the team executes both motions effectively, understands when to prioritise each and consistently delivers high-quality pipeline to the sales organisation.


Responsibilities

  • Own EMEA & APJ Sales Development Representative performance - deliver against regional meeting, SQO and pipeline targets, with clear focus on the inputs and behaviors that drive results
  • Translate global strategy into EMEA & APJ execution - ensure global SDR priorities, playbooks and programmes are adopted effectively across the region
  • Build a daily coaching culture - coach reps through call reviews, roleplay, 1:1s and live feedback to continuously improve performance
  • Develop and retain talent - identify high performers, create development plans and address performance gaps with clear expectations and support
  • Drive strong outbound and inbound execution - ensure consistent standards across prospecting, sequencing, qualification, follow-up and handoffs
  • Identify and resolve regional blockers - surface issues across process, data, tooling, routing and skills, and work with the Global Head and cross-functional teams to address them
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing - strengthen meeting quality and pipeline conversion while ensuring EMEA & APJ SDR activity aligns with campaigns and ABM priorities
  • Feed EMEA insight into the global SDR organisation - share what is working, what isn't and where regional learnings should influence the wider SDR strategy


 

What we're looking for

  • Have 2+ years’ experience managing SDR or BDR teams in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Have a proven track record of delivering against pipeline and revenue targets through a Sales Development team
  • Have experience leading both outbound and inbound motions, with a strong understanding of what drives conversion across each
  • A coaching-first leadership style - you spend time with reps, listen to calls, run roleplays and actively develop capability
  • Have experience developing SDR talent, managing performance and creating clear pathways for progression
  • Have commercial acumen - you understand pipeline economics, conversion rates and the levers that influence SDR performance
  • Data-driven and operationally disciplined, with the ability to identify performance gaps and turn insight into action
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and bringing structure, energy and accountability to a team

You will partner closely with Account Executives and channel partners to drive net-new and upsell opportunities across the Mid-Market and Enterprise segments, supporting the full sales cycle from discovery through to close. This is a high-impact specialist sales position where your deep UCaaS expertise shapes how customers understand and adopt the future of business communications. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our London, UK office.

The Zoom Phone sales team sits at the heart of Zoom Workplace, helping organisations replace legacy telephony with a cloud-native, AI-first communications platform. We work alongside Account Executives and channel partners with a consultative, customer-centric approach, showing businesses how voice, meetings, chat, and AI come together in a single solution. Our mission is to grow Zoom’s presence across UK&I by demonstrating that modern telephony is about unlocking the intelligence within every conversation.

job.title: Head of Sales Operations
job.description:
What you can expect

You will design the strategy and systems powering Zoom's go-to-market execution. You will partner cross-functionally to build a data-driven operating model. You will transform how Zoom forecasts and grows.

About the Team
Our team powers the planning, analytics, and systems behind Zoom's revenue engine. We partner cross-functionally turning strategy into execution. We make growth predictable and scalable.

Responsibilities

  • Leading end-to-end revenue planning — including annual planning, segmentation, territory design, capacity modeling, quota setting, and investment allocation — to translate company strategy into an executable go-to-market plan.

  • Owning the forecasting operating model and pipeline analytics infrastructure, building disciplined processes that give leadership clear visibility into performance, risk, and opportunity.

  • Driving Customer Success Operations including renewal models, churn analysis, account health scoring, adoption metrics, and expansion analytics to connect new business, retention, and customer value realization.

  • Partnering with Sales, Finance, HR, Marketing, and Data & Automation teams to operationalize compensation plans, pipeline generation, funnel conversion, and AI-driven productivity improvements across the revenue organization.

What we’re looking for

Essential:

  • Demonstrate significant experience leading Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • Apply deep expertise in revenue planning, coverage models, territory design, capacity planning, and quota setting to build scalable go-to-market frameworks.

  • Build and manage forecasting models, pipeline analytics, deal inspection processes, and executive-level revenue visibility.

  • Design and improve sales processes, CRM governance, operating rhythms, and rules of engagement across a complex revenue organization.

  • Develop and operationalize sales compensation plans, incentive structures, commission rules, and performance tracking aligned to company strategy.

  • Lead or partner closely with Customer Success Operations on renewals, adoption, churn analysis, account health, and risk scoring.

  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership, driving cross-functional alignment in a matrixed organization.

Preferred:

  • Bring working knowledge of marketing funnel dynamics, lead management, pipeline generation, campaign attribution, and how AI and automation can improve revenue execution and seller productivity.

job.title: SDK Engineer
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect

SDK Engineer will be responsible for cross-platform development, designing new features & and supporting the client & server teams to ensure Zoom Phone SDK is reliable and stable. They will provide continuous enhancements, and work with both internal & external customers on any issues they may have.

Responsibilities:  

  • Design the overall architecture for Zoom Phone tasks and communicate interfaces with server and client teams. This includes detailed control flow at SIP level, specific command requests and responses between client, server, and UI layers.
  • Implement new features and unit test cases according to new feature implementation. Drive tasks across teams and make sure roll out features follow the release plan.
  • Conduct integration testing with server and client teams.
  • Use Windows Performance Analyzer (WPA) or relevant tool, to prevent memory leaks in SDK code.
  • Use Checkmarx to scan and fix SDK code issues.
  • Use User-Mode Dump Heap (UMDH) to capture and analyze heap memory allocations for a process.
  • Perform sanity testing to prevent crash and regression issues. Perform SDK API auto testing based on an internal tool.
  • Maintain auto testing tools and improve those tools to support more automatic testing scenarios.
  • Review customer tickets and work with support team, analyze control flow, SIP flow and determine root cause.
  • Examine client problem report on demand, analyze call details, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Review bugs with the reporter to understand bugs and reproduced steps, then perform root; cause analysis and determine a solution.
  • Perform integration testing at the development branch and release branch to ensure the fix has no negative impact.
  • Work closely with the product management team to define requirements, create user stories and collect use cases on new features.
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to confirm final design scope and assign task owners. Support client team with fire drill testing before rolling out new releases and check the production crash reports after new release roll-out.
  • Work on enhancements for our automatic client report analysis tool.
  • Track critical and important issues found in client problem reports.

What we're looking for:

Requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or a foreign degree equivalent. Requires 4 years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Requires 4 years of experience with the following skillsets:

  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing C/C++ and object-oriented programming in task design, fixing bugs, and implementing development work;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing Wireshark to analyze VOIP traffic calls in network programming;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing IDE tools including Microsoft Studio for debugging code;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing Valgrind to perform memory checks;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing Flame Graph to check CPU cost information and code enhancements;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing network protocols including TCP, UDP, TLS, RTP, SRTP, and RCTP in real-time traffic transmission and audio quality enhancements;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing VoIP technologies including RFC2833, RFC3550 and RFC 5760 in real time communication to control system traffic, control audio quality, and develop solutions to ensure quality user experience;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing open-source projects including SIP stacks (PJSIP, reSIProcate, FreeSWITCH) to support fundamental layer covering low-level SIP protocol parsing;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing integrated development environments (IDEs) including Visual Studio in software development.
  • Telecommuting work arrangement permitted. Position may work in various unanticipated locations throughout the U.S. Position does not require U.S. or domestic travel.

Zoom Communications, Inc.

You will drive a programmatic approach while maintaining a solutions-based focus to address evolving business needs. Reporting to the Head of Infrastructure & Client Experience, you will manage a team of Infrastructure Engineers across four key functions in this role. You will partner closely with product teams to support the future of AI.

About the Team

We are Zoom's "customer zero" for internal cloud, platform, and IAM infrastructure. We use an SRE mindset, automation, and self-service tooling to optimize performance and security. We do this so every Zoomie can do their best work.

Responsibilities

  • Managing the strategic design, engineering, and operations of enterprise-wide IAM infrastructure. Serve as the primary technical authority for all IAM initiatives across the organization. Cover identity lifecycle management, RBAC, ABAC, PAM, and zero-trust frameworks. Manage IDP solutions (Okta, Cloudflare, Entra ID, Google Cloud Identity) with SSO. Maintain directory services and authentication (LDAP, Active Directory, Radius, MFA, certificate management, federation). Lead enterprise application integration across Zoom, Sales, HRMS, and SaaS platforms, with automated provisioning, de-provisioning, and access governance. Operate IGA platforms driving access certifications, segregation of duties (SoD), role mining, and User Access Reviews (UAR). Remediate IAM technical debt and consolidate legacy systems. Ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR through continuous monitoring, access reviews, and audit trails, in partnership with Security, Compliance, and Audit teams.

  • Managing a team which manages EKS and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) platforms, leveraging ArgoCD for GitOps deployments, Atlantis for Terraform automation, Nginx for ingress control, certificate management, and AWS/Proxmox infrastructure.

  • Driving AI and automation initiatives using scripting languages and APIs — including PowerShell, Bash, Python, and Golang — for data transformation and workflow automation.

  • Implementing and managing configuration management tools including Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and SALT Stack to maintain scalable and reliable infrastructure.

  • Managing platform services including Observability tooling, NetBox IPAM/DCIM, and other core infrastructure applications.

  • Leading the transformation from monitoring to observability by partnering with infrastructure service owners on a Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki observability stack.

  • Maintaining expertise across cloud IaaS environments including GCP, AWS, Azure, Hyperconverged Hardware, and VMware/Proxmox, following CI/CD best practices with Jira and GitLab.

What we’re looking for

  • Bring 10 to 15 years in IT or similar technology fields

  • 5 years managing infrastructure teams.

  • Show a proven track record managing, building, scaling, and improving services.

  • Apply an understanding of Enterprise Architecture and governance best practices.

  • Drive continuous improvement and deliver results against clear timelines with a service-oriented, proactive approach.

  • Operate with a results-driven, entrepreneurial mindset; a degree in CS, Engineering, or MIS, or equivalent practical experience.

job.description:
What You Can Expect

The Federal Solution Engineer at Zoom serves as a trusted technical advisor for Federal clients. You will translate complex technical requirements into actionable product recommendations, test customer environments, and champion feature requests that shape Zoom's roadmap from the field.

Deep telephony expertise and a passion for AI are your superpowers here. You will partner with customers and Account Executives to design creative, outcome-driven workflows that make a real impact. Hands-on experience with the Zoom platform or a competitive equivalent is essential.

About the Team

Zoom's Federal Solutions Engineering team bridges government communication and advanced cloud technology, supporting Federal Civilian and DoD agencies nationwide. The team helps modernize collaboration via Zoom's FedRAMP-authorized platform.

Responsibilities

  • Providing product presentations and demonstrations, creating deployment designs and plans, implementing proofs of concept, and preparing responses to RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs.
  • Maintaining advanced proficiency across video, phone, customer experience, artificial intelligence, APIs/SDKs, networking, PBX, desktop, and mobile technologies consistently.
  • Serving as the trusted technical advisor, acting as the lead advocate for Federal clients during every stage of the sales cycle.
  • Supporting Account Executives by proposing and designing solutions that address significant collaboration challenges faced by customers.
  • Translating technical needs into product development suggestions while driving customer feature requests internally within Zoom.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer in pre-sales, with a strong command of product-related areas and the ability to clearly represent technical solutions, including Unified Communications, video, web conferencing, and voice.

  • 7+ years of experience supporting technical sales in Federal Civilian Government or DoD environments is preferred (e.g., DHS, SEC, IRS, VA, DISA, U.S. Navy, U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army).

job.title: Solutions Engineer, Workvivo (APJ)
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will serve as the technical anchor of every pre-sales engagement across APJ, partnering with Account Executives, Customer Experience teams, and Channel Partners to translate complex enterprise requirements into compelling, tailored Workvivo solutions. You will lead consultative discovery sessions, deliver persona-based product demonstrations, and drive technical wins across Workvivo's full portfolio spanning Workvivo HQ, HQ Agent, Seer, Chat, Workvivo TV, and our integrations ecosystem. Fluency in both English and Japanese is essential: you will lead customer-facing engagements, executive briefings, and technical workshops in either language across a diverse region that includes Japan, Singapore, Australia, India, and Southeast Asia. You will report to the Regional Sales Leader in APJ, with a dotted line to the Global Head of Solutions. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Singapore office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Workvivo Solutions Engineering team is a high-performing, globally connected group that sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, and customer success, directly influencing deal outcomes and product direction across some of the world's largest employers. In APJ, one of Workvivo's fastest-growing markets, we are redefining how enterprises communicate, listen, and act through AI-native products like Workvivo HQ and Seer. Our team achieved a 97% engagement score and exceeded revenue targets at 106% last quarter, and we are building on that momentum together.

Responsibilities

  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that uncover customer goals, pain points, existing technology stacks, and success metrics, and translate findings into proposed Workvivo solutions tied to measurable business outcomes.

  • Design and deliver tailored, persona-based product demonstrations across Workvivo HQ, HQ Agent, Seer, Chat, Workvivo TV, and Advanced Analytics, connecting platform capabilities to the priorities of CHRO, CPO, CIO, and Head of Internal Communications stakeholders.

  • Own the Solutions Engineering motion across APJ, managing active opportunities end-to-end through qualification, technical validation, proof-of-concept, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, and commercial close via Salesforce.

  • Serve as the primary SE for Japanese-language opportunities, leading discovery, demonstrations, and technical conversations in Japanese with full fluency.

  • Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap priorities through structured feature requests and customer feedback, with particular focus on localisation and APJ-specific requirements.

  • Enable and support Channel Partners and generalist SEs across APJ with Workvivo product knowledge, demo best practices, and competitive positioning.

  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Onboarding teams to ensure seamless deal handovers and contribute to expansion opportunities across Seer, HQ Agent, and Advanced Analytics.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within a SaaS organisation or the technology industry, or equivalent experience.

  • Fluency in both English and Japanese, written and spoken, with demonstrated ability to lead customer-facing engagements, technical workshops, and executive presentations in either language.

  • Proven track record supporting complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with contributions to six-figure-plus ARR deal closures.

  • Strong technical acumen across APIs, integrations, SSO/SAML, HRIS data flows, enterprise search, and AI/ML concepts, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, translating complex platform capabilities into compelling business narratives tailored to senior executive personas.

  • Self-starter who operates with autonomy across a geographically dispersed region, managing competing priorities and multiple deal cycles simultaneously, with willingness to travel within APJ approximately 20-30% of the time.

  • Experience in Employee Experience, HR Technology, Internal Communications, or Digital Workplace, or hands-on familiarity with AI-powered enterprise search or employee-facing AI agents, is a strong plus.

job.title: EMEA Field Marketing Manager - Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo enhances organizational connections, engagement, and communication through its AI-powered employee experience platform. Acquired by Zoom in 2023, it blends SaaS agility with global technology innovation.

The Field Marketing Manager EMEA oversees regional marketing efforts. Responsibilities include executing a tiered ABM strategy for key accounts, creating regional field calendars, and collaborating closely with Sales teams to drive pipeline growth.

This impactful role requires managing regional initiatives, fostering partnerships, and delivering measurable results. It offers an opportunity to lead efforts and build meaningful collaborations.

The position operates in a hybrid capacity from Ireland or the Netherlands.

About the Team

You'll join the Global Field & Strategic Events team, sitting within the broader Growth & Demand Generation function. Our buyers are enterprise leaders including CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications leaders, so this role is built around account based marketing as its operating model.

Responsibilities

  • Executing the EMEA field marketing strategy as a tiered ABM approach: 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account groups, and 1:many for broader segments.

  • Building and managing the regional field calendar in collaboration with Sales and SDR leadership, customized to account tier, concentration, and deal stage.

  • Owning a pipeline target for the EMEA region, generating and accelerating pipeline across all account levels, and maintaining consistent standards with other demand channels.

  • Supporting the strategy and execution of global flagship events, such as Workvivo Engage, as part of the broader ABX initiative in EMEA.

  • Managing the regional field and events budget while ensuring accountability for pipeline efficiency rather than focusing solely on event volume or attendance.

  • Building and maintaining the transition process with Sales Development and Sales ensures every account receives timely, coordinated follow-up aligned with the origin's engagement level. Partnering with Revenue Operations to manage attribution and route leads effectively across all three tiers within the United States.

  • Executing the playbooks and processes outlined by the Global Lead of Field and Strategic Events while contributing to their continuous improvement.

  • Representing EMEA field and events performance in regional and global reporting, with pipeline contribution as the primary focus.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in field marketing, ABM, or integrated marketing, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment.

  • Demonstrate experience executing a tiered ABM motion: 1:1 for top accounts, 1:few for clusters, and 1:many/ABX for scale - not just familiarity with the concept.

  • Demonstrate expertise in optimizing pipeline efficiency beyond event volume, focusing on cost-effectiveness and measurable outcomes rather than attendance or brand metrics.

  • Manage a regional field budget and report pipeline contributions to senior leadership effectively and accurately.

  • Collaborate effectively across functions while working closely with Sales, Sales Development, and Demand Generation teams to achieve shared objectives.

  • Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology. Demonstrate knowledge in HR technology, employee experience, or a related field.

  • Present performance data and strategy effectively to senior leadership.

  • Reside in the EMEA region and travel regionally when necessary.

job.title: DevOps Engineer
job.description:
DevOps Engineer


What you can expect

We seek a DevOps Engineer to maintain, scale, and enhance reliable SaaS platforms operating in distributed, large-scale environments. This role emphasizes operational excellence, automation, observability, and performance to ensure service availability and scalability. Responsibilities include managing initiatives from start to finish, leading critical incident responses, and collaborating with engineering teams to implement lasting improvements benefiting customers directly.


About the Team

With eight specialized departments, the engineering team functions as a highly collaborative, diverse powerhouse. Each department mission is to deliver seamless and innovative communication solutions. These range from software development and machine learning to quality assurance teams that work to create and maintain Zoom's user-friendly interfaces and robust infrastructure. The team continues to push the boundaries of communication technology, bringing people together regardless of their physical distance.


Responsibilities

  • Operating, scaling, and continuously improving software-as-a-service production platforms across distributed environments.
  • Designing and implementing uninterrupted solutions to ensure continuous operation for services with an availability target of 99.999%.
  • Developing and maintaining disaster recovery strategies across data centers located in various regions.
  • Developing and maintaining automation, tools, and scripts to enhance deployment efficiency while minimizing manual tasks and improving overall operational workflows.
  • Implementing and improving monitoring, alerting, and observability ensures proactive identification and prevention of potential issues.
  • Owning system performance, availability, and scalability for services that directly engage with customers.
  • Analyzing system behavior and performance data to pinpoint bottlenecks and uncover optimization opportunities.
  • Leading incident response efforts, performing root cause analysis, and implementing lasting remediation measures to address identified issues effectively.

What we’re looking for

  • 6–10 years of experience supporting and operating SaaS production systems in DevOps or SRE roles
  • Design systems that are highly available and meet uptime targets as high as 99.999%.
  • Demonstrate expertise in designing and implementing disaster recovery strategies across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrate expertise managing distributed systems within production environments that directly serve customers.
  • Demonstrate expertise in handling incidents, managing on-call operations, and conducting thorough root cause analysis to address and resolve issues effectively.

job.title: Account Executive, Commercial, KSA
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is looking for a strategic Account Executive to drive digital transformation within our Commercial sector. In this role, you will act as the business leader of your territory or accounts. Moving beyond simple transactional sales to orchestrate complex, multi-product solution selling. You will balance net-new customer acquisition with strategic expansion of our install base, leveraging the full platform (UCaaS, CCaaS, CX, AI) to solve critical business challenges.

About the Team

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Building and managing a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting across existing and new customer accounts to drive consistent revenue growth.

  • Orchestrating data-driven territory plans by leveraging insights and consumption trends to prioritize high-propensity accounts and optimize coverage.

  • Executing hybrid prospecting strategies that integrate social selling, partner co-selling, and direct outreach to uncover hidden opportunities within existing and new accounts.

  • Driving product consumption and adoption by identifying unused entitlements, converting them into active usage, and generating measurable business value.

  • Engaging C-Level, VP-Level, and functional decision-makers across Finance, HR, Operations, and Procurement to align solutions with strategic business goals and digital transformation roadmaps.

  • Negotiating complex, multi-horizon commercial agreements that include multi-year commitments and professional services to ensure long-term value and minimize churn.

  • Creating and delivering impactful presentations, proposals, and Quarterly Business Reviews that demonstrate ROI, benchmark performance, and outline future-state roadmaps aligned with customer objectives.

What we're looking for

  • Have proven Account Executive experience across UCaaS, CCaaS, and CX, with success in outbound prospecting, new logo acquisition, and push the status quo through tailored customer insights.

  • Demonstrate knowledge of Cloud Economics, including CAPEX vs. OPEX models, and build TCO and financial impact models to justify investments to financial stakeholders.

  • Use CRM systems and sales tools to manage pipeline development, forecasting, and deal progression with precision and accountability.

  • Maintain accurate commit forecasts and mutual action plans to ensure visibility, predictability, and alignment across all opportunities.

  • Exhibit resilience, adaptability, and a growth mindset while fostering collaboration, relationship-building, and effective communication across teams.

  • Show continuous learning and evolution of sales approaches to stay driven in changing markets and customer environments.

مدير حسابات، القطاع التجاري، الإمارات العربية المتحدة

ما يمكنك توقعه

تبحث Zoom عن مدير حسابات استراتيجي لدفع التحول الرقمي داخل قطاعنا التجاري في الإمارات العربية المتحدة. في هذا الدور، ستعمل كقائد أعمال لمنطقتك، والانتقال إلى ما هو أبعد من مبيعات المعاملات البسيطة لتنظيم بيع الحلول المعقدة والمتعددة المنتجات. ستقوم بموازنة اكتساب العملاء الجدد مع التوسع الاستراتيجي لقاعدة التثبيت الخاصة بنا، والاستفادة من النظام الأساسي الكامل ل Zoom (UCaaS و CCaaS و CX و AI) لحل تحديات الأعمال الحرجة.

حول الفريق

يعد فريق مبيعات Zoom قوة ديناميكية تقود نجاح الشركة. مع التركيز على تقديم حلول اتصالات متطورة للعملاء في جميع القطاعات، يتفاعل الفريق بشغف مع العملاء في جميع أنحاء العالم. من خلال الشراكات الاستراتيجية والنهج الذي يركز على العملاء، يلعبون دورًا محوريًا في توسيع الحضور العالمي ل Zoom وضمان تسخير الشركات للإمكانات الكاملة للتعاون الافتراضي.

المسؤوليات

  • بناء وإدارة خط مبيعات قوي من خلال التنقيب الخارجي الاستباقي عبر حسابات العملاء الحالية والجديدة لدفع نمو الإيرادات المتسق

  • تنظيم خطط المناطق القائمة على البيانات من خلال الاستفادة من الرؤى واتجاهات الاستهلاك لتحديد أولويات الحسابات عالية الميل وتحسين التغطية

  • تنفيذ استراتيجيات التنقيب الهجينة التي تدمج البيع الاجتماعي والبيع المشترك للشركاء والتواصل المباشر للكشف عن الفرص داخل الحسابات الحالية والجديدة

  • تعزيز استهلاك المنتج واعتماده من خلال تحديد الاستحقاقات غير المستخدمة وتحويلها إلى استخدام نشط وتوليد قيمة تجارية قابلة للقياس

  • إشراك صانعي القرار من المستوى التنفيذي ومستوى نائب الرئيس والوظيفي عبر الشؤون المالية والموارد البشرية والعمليات والمشتريات لمواءمة الحلول مع أهداف الأعمال الاستراتيجية وخرائط طريق التحول الرقمي

  • التفاوض على اتفاقيات تجارية معقدة متعددة السنوات تتضمن خدمات احترافية لضمان القيمة طويلة الأجل وتقليل معدل التوقف

  • إنشاء وتقديم عروض تقديمية ومقترحات ومراجعات أعمال ربع سنوية مؤثرة توضح عائد الاستثمار والأداء المعياري وتحدد خرائط الطريق المستقبلية بما يتماشى مع أهداف العملاء

ما نبحث عنه

  • خبرة مثبتة كمدير حسابات في UCaaS و CCaaS و CX، مع نجاح موثق في التنقيب الخارجي واكتساب عملاء جدد ودفع التغيير من خلال رؤى العملاء المصممة خصيصًا

  • معرفة قوية باقتصاديات الحوسبة السحابية، بما في ذلك نماذج CAPEX مقابل OPEX، مع القدرة على بناء نماذج التكلفة الإجمالية للملكية والأثر المالي لتبرير الاستثمارات لأصحاب المصلحة الماليين

  • إتقان أنظمة CRM وأدوات المبيعات لإدارة تطوير خطوط الأنابيب والتنبؤ وتطور الصفقات بدقة ومساءلة

  • سجل حافل في الحفاظ على توقعات الالتزام الدقيقة وخطط العمل المتبادل لضمان الرؤية والقدرة على التنبؤ والمواءمة عبر جميع الفرص

  • المرونة والقدرة على التكيف وعقلية النمو مع مهارات قوية في التعاون وبناء العلاقات والتواصل بين الفرق

  • الالتزام بالتعلم المستمر وتطوير أساليب المبيعات للبقاء فعالاً في الأسواق المتغيرة وبيئات العملاء

job.title: Partner Sales, Sub Reseller focus (Tokyo/Osaka based)
job.description:
What you can expect

We're looking for new partner sales to join our Japan team. You will be responsible for building, enabling, and driving revenue growth through our partner ecosystem in Japan. This role combines strategic enablement expertise with revenue growth responsibility, transforming partner capabilities while delivering measurable business results. This role is based in Tokyo or Osaka, Japan, reporting to the Head of Channels, Japan.

About the Team

The dynamic Zoom sales team drives company success by delivering cutting-edge communication solutions worldwide. They expand global presence and help businesses harness virtual collaboration through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement comprehensive enablement programs that directly improve partner sales performance
  • Develop partner capabilities for revenue acceleration rather than just maintaining relationships
  • Create and execute quarterly business plans with partners that align to revenue targets
  • Analyze partner performance data and implement changes that improve results
  • Balance providing technical guidance with holding partners accountable for revenue targets
  • Drive measurable business results for Zoom's Japan ecosystem

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of sales experience in a technology company with a focus on enablement and performance optimization
  • Proven track record of developing partner capabilities that translate to revenue growth
  • Experience with structured enablement methodologies and performance analytics
  • Strong data-driven decision making and analytical thinking skills
  • Fluent business Japanese skills (This role is based in Tokyo)
  • English skills (verbal, writing, reading) highly welcomed
  • Experience in channel business within the Japan market
  • Flexibility for rapidly changing environment and nimble learning ability
  • Ability to conduct compelling demonstrations that showcase the strengths of SaaS products to both channel partners and end users


職務概要

私たちは、新たなパートナー営業をZoom Japanに迎えたいと考えています。このポジションでは、日本におけるパートナーエコシステムの構築、醸成、そして収益成長の推進を担当していただきます。この役割は戦略的なイネーブルメントの専門知識と収益成長の責任を組み合わせ、パートナー企業とともに測定可能なビジネス成果を提供します。一般的なパートナールート営業ではなく、パートナーとの新規案件の創出も積極的に行うポジションです。東京を拠点とし、日本のチャネル責任者に報告します。

チームについて

ダイナミックなZoomセールスチームは、最先端のコミュニケーションソリューションを世界中に提供することで会社の成功を推進しています。戦略的パートナーシップと顧客中心のアプローチを通じて、グローバルなプレゼンスを拡大し、企業がバーチャルコラボレーションを活用できるよう支援しています。


主な職務内容

  • パートナーの販売パフォーマンスを直接向上させる包括的なイネーブルメントプログラムの設計と実施
  • 単なる関係維持ではなく、収益加速のためのパートナー能力開発
  • 収益目標に沿ったパートナーとの四半期ビジネスプランの作成と実行
  • パートナーパフォーマンスデータの分析と結果改善のための変更実施
  • 技術的ガイダンスの提供と収益目標に対するパートナーの責任管理のバランス
  • Zoom Japanのパートナーエコシステムにおける測定可能なビジネス成果の推進

求める人材

  • Tech企業での5年以上の営業経験（パートナーイネーブルメントとパフォーマンス最適化のご経験をお持ちの方）
  • 収益成長につながるパートナーのビジネス開発経験
  • 構造化されたイネーブルメント手法とパフォーマンス分析の経験
  • データ駆動型の意思決定と分析的思考スキル
  • 流暢な日本語スキル（このポジションは東京勤務です）
  • 英語スキル（文書、読解）*会話できる方歓迎
  • 日本市場におけるチャネルビジネスの経験
  • 急速に変化する環境への柔軟性と俊敏な学習能力
  • チャネルパートナーとエンドユーザーの両方にSaaS製品の強みを示す説得力のあるデモンストレーション能力

なぜZoomのチャネルチームでのキャリアが面白い？

このポジションは、日本のパートナーエコシステムにおける成長の触媒となるユニークな機会を提供します。優れた関係構築とパフォーマンス責任のバランスを取りながら、パートナーの能力を開発し、測定可能なビジネス成果を推進します。イネーブルメントと収益達成の両方に優れている方からのご応募をお待ちしています。

job.title: Video AI Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect​

As a Video AI Engineer, you’ll enhance video codecs, video generation, and real-time 3D reconstruction to improve video quality, immersion, and performance in Zoom products. You will work across our stack, developing software ranging from Web Server to business application layers for our distributed, cloud-hosted backend. Working alongside leading experts in the field, you’ll deliver happiness to our users and grow your knowledge base every day.

About the Team

With eight specialized departments, the engineering team functions as a highly collaborative, diverse powerhouse. Each department mission is to deliver seamless and innovative communication solutions. These range from software development and machine learning to quality assurance teams that work to create and maintain Zoom's user-friendly interfaces and robust infrastructure. The team continues to push the boundaries of communication technology, bringing people together regardless of their physical distance.

Responsibilities

  • Building and developing video and generative video processing applications on both desktop and mobile systems.

  • Participating in research and performance evaluation of video processing, video generation, and 3D reconstruction algorithms.

  • Designing and developing algorithms in Zoom’s video and 3D reconstruction processing pipelines at both module and system levels.

  • Implementing video, neural rendering, and 3D Gaussian Splatting algorithms with modular, well-organized, and production-ready code.

  • Optimizing video, generative, and 3D reconstruction algorithms to achieve real-time performance on corresponding platforms.

  • Customizing, integrating, and shipping deep learning models—including video generative models and 3D neural rendering models—across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android.

  • Setting up test environments, developing test tools, and designing unit tests for runtime verification of video and 3D pipeline components.

What we’re looking for

  • Hold a PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field; or a Masters degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or 7 years of equivalent professional experience.

  • Have experience with C/C++ or Objective-C, and Python, talking avatar/head/portrait(with released projects and top conference papers).

  • Have hands-on experience with video generation or video diffusion models, neural rendering techniques (e.g., NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting), and 3D reconstruction systems.

  • Have hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as generative models, diffusion models, discriminative models, or transfer learning.

  • Possess experience with or a solid understanding of at least one deepfake detection approach. This includes biometric analysis–based methods, vision-language model (VLM)–based techniques, interactive behavior analysis, or multimodal signal modeling that leverages visual, temporal, and audio cues.

  • Have familiarity with multi-threaded programming and communication mechanisms.

  • Have understanding of multimedia stream data processing flows, ideally including 3D scene or point cloud pipelines.

$137,700.00

Maximum:

$275,400.00

job.title: Billing Specialist
job.description:
What you can expect

Join a team that sits at the intersection of finance, customer experience, and operations. You'll own billing inquiries end-to-end investigating discrepancies, resolving disputes, and ensuring customers are billed accurately and on time. Every day brings a mix of analytical problem-solving and direct customer interaction, giving you visibility across systems. Your work has a direct impact.

About the Team

The Billing Operations team is the engine behind Zoom's financial accuracy. We partner closely with Renewals, Collections, and Engineering to resolve complex billing issues and continuously improve the systems our customers rely on. We're a team that takes ownership when something breaks, we fix it; when a process can be better, we improve it. You'll work in a high-volume environment where precision matters, collaboration is constant, and your contributions are visible to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Investigating and resolving customer billing inquiries end-to-end via ServiceNow, phone, chat, and Zoom delivering timely, accurate outcomes

  • Analysing accounts and troubleshooting billing portal issues, providing clear solutions to complex customer challenges

  • Processing invoices, manual adjustments, and credit/debit modifications while maintaining accuracy and compliance standards

  • Reconciling payments and supporting the Collections team with dispute resolution, escalation management, and customer account oversight

  • Partnering with Engineering, Renewals, and the Billing Manager to improve processes, resolve systemic issues, and leverage AI tools for billing efficiency

What we’re looking for

  • Be fluent in English. Fluency in German is an advantage.

  • Bring at least 1 year of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or revenue operations billing ownership is required, not collections-only

  • Demonstrate experience resolving billing disputes and managing customer escalations in a professional, empathetic manner

  • Show experience in customer-facing support or customer experience roles, with strong verbal and written communication in English

  • Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and resolve billing queries accurately

  • Demonstrate experience using AI tools or automation within billing, revenue, or collections workflows

  • Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and resolve billing queries accurately

  • Bring experience working with ServiceNow or Zuora (or similar billing/ticketing platforms)

  • Show proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with billing or CRM platforms

job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketing
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What to expect:

We are looking for highly motivated individuals who would be excited to partner with our stakeholders to develop data products & solutions that will impact hundreds of millions of our users across the world. Expert communication, problem-solving, and having an innovative spirit will be the keys to success in this role.

You'll be working cross-functionally with teams of Product Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Sales and Marketing Managers on some of the most critical projects in the company.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and conduct deep-dive research to identify opportunities for revenue growth and expansion of products to support consumer and Small Businesses;
  • Design, develop, and program methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyze unstructured, diverse data sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement;
  • Develop and code software programs, algorithms and automated processes to cleanse, integrate and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources;
  • Research and develop audience segmentation, propensity and recommender models to enable personalized experiences, improving customer engagement and increasing sales;
  • Manage data governance and best practices to ensure data integrity and privacy by design;
  • Identify impactful metrics to understand the performance of business initiatives and products, define key performance indicator metrics, and ingrain these metrics into the teams’ day-to-day decision-making; and
  • Interpret and communicate insights and findings from analysis and experiments to product, service, and business managers.

What we're looking for:

Requires a Master's degree in Business Analytics and Project Management, Data Science, a related field, or a foreign degree equivalent. Must have 5 years of experience in job offered or related occupation. Must have 5 years of experience in with the following:

  • 5 years of experience performing data science within an eCommerce, Marketing, sales or customer analytics environment to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement;
  • 5 years of experience designing and operationalizing scalable Machine Learning models or audience segmentation, customer churn, and product purchasing propensity;
  • 5 years of experience utilizing causal inference analysis and experimentation design for A/B Testing;
  • 5 years of experience utilizing statistical modeling and techniques to analyze large-scale customer, product, and transactional data to identify behavioral patterns, predict future outcomes, and support data-driven business decisions. This includes applying methods such as regression analysis, classification models, clustering, hypothesis testing, time-series analysis, and experimental design to measure the impact of product and marketing initiatives, estimate customer lifetime value, forecast demand, assess churn risk, and evaluate revenue growth opportunities;
  • 5 years of experience applying data processing and modeling using SQL and Python to extract, transform, integrate, and analyze large and complex datasets from multiple internal and external data sources;
  • 5 years of experience utilizing big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, Flink, or equivalent distributed computing frameworks to process, analyze, and model massive datasets that exceed the capacity of traditional systems.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is looking for an innovative and skilled Staff Software Engineer to join our Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) team. The focus will be on improving the quality, reliability, and performance of Zoom's AI-powered virtual agent - an intelligent system that autonomously resolves customer inquiries before escalating to a human agent.


About the Team

The Zoom Virtual Agent team is committed to transforming customer experience through AI-driven automation. We are passionate about building intelligent, production-grade systems that handle real customer interactions at scale - reducing the need for human escalation and delivering faster, more accurate resolutions. We operate with a startup mentality: fast-moving, high-ownership, and focused on building foundational technology that will define the future of AI-powered customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnosing and resolving AI agent quality issues — identifying whether failures stem from model behavior, prompt design, or system architecture, and driving the fix end-to-end.
  • Designing and optimizing system prompt architectures, few-shot examples, and prompt chains to improve agent reliability, accuracy, and resolution rates.
  • Building and maintaining evaluation pipelines to continuously measure agent quality, detect regressions, and validate improvements before production deployment.
  • Architecting scalable, maintainable systems that support high-performance AI agent operation at scale.
  • Collaborating with product managers, model teams, and engineering leadership across US and China time zones to align on quality goals and delivery timelines.
  • Setting the technical direction for agent quality on the team — mentor engineers, influence the roadmap, and drive measurable improvements in customer-facing outcomes.

What we’re looking for

  • Have an advance degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with rich system architecture knowledge & skills. With at least 3–5 years working directly on AI-powered products, LLM-based systems, or conversational AI agents in production.
  • Have track record of diagnosing and improving AI agent quality — with specific examples of identifying failure modes and driving measurable improvements.
  • Have prompt engineering skills, including system prompt design, context management, and prompt chain optimization. Having DSPy/APO/GEPA experience is a plus.
  • Have engineering scope — experience leading technical direction for a product area or team, with the ability to both design systems and execute on them.
  • Have experience deploying and operating LLM-based systems in production at scale — not just research or prototyping.
  • Have experience with ML or model training is a plus — candidates who have transitioned from MLE into SWE roles are strongly welcomed.

  • Develop and maintain Zoom chat and meeting modules using React or Vue, integrating Zoom SDK to implement real-time messaging, participant management, and multimedia collaboration features.
  • Implement and optimize hybrid WebView applications across platforms, build communication bridges between JavaScript and native layers, and apply local asset caching strategies to support localized resource delivery.

  • Lead and coordinate a distributed engineering team across multiple time zones, facilitating multilingual communication and ensuring aligned delivery across international stakeholders.

Requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, a related field, or a foreign degree equivalent. Must have 8 years of experience in job offered or related occupation. Must have 8 years of experience in the following:

  • Must have 8 years of experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining frontend codebases using JavaScript (JS) and TypeScript (TS) as primary programming languages.
  • Must have 8 years of experience in implementing user interfaces and single-page applications (SPAs) utilizing both React and Vue frameworks in production settings.
  • Must have 8 years of experience in designing, developing, and conducting accessibility (AX) audits and remediation to meet WCAG 2.1 standards, ensuring screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation support, and ARIA attribute implementation.

    • Design & implement prod.-grade integrations w/ enterprise platforms requiring OAuth 2.0/OIDC auth. flows, webhook mgmt., real-time data sync., & secure multi-tenant data sharing.
    • Architect & maintain backwards-compatible REST APIs & SDKs w/ rate limiting, idempotency, error handling, & dev. docs.
    • Ensure reliability through circuit breakers, retry logic w/ exponential backoff, & graceful degradation. Enable dev. partners by solving complex integration challenges & providing tech. guidance.

    • Architect & build prod. AI-powered features incl. frontend UI & UX integrating LLM svcs. w/ prompt engineering, context mgmt., & conversational workflows.
    • Design agent-based orchestration systems w/ function calling & tool use patterns.

job.description:
What you can Expect
Zoom seeks an Enterprise Account Executive based in India. In this role, you will own and drive net-new enterprise logo acquisition across India's largest organisations — including major conglomerates. You will be selling Zoom's AI-powered communication and collaboration platform, spanning video meetings, phone, chat, whiteboard, customer experience, employee experience and more.


This is a hunting role — you will be expected to self-generate pipeline, navigate complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and engage at C-suite level to close high-value, multi-year deals. Diversity is a core value at Zoom, with a strong focus on equity and inclusion.



About the Team
The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.

As a Machine Learning Engineer on our GenAI Engineering team, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Zoom AI through innovative engineering solutions. You'll take the lead in developing and enhancing AI algorithms, techniques, and solutions for our AI Companion product. Working closely with experienced researchers and engineers, you'll be part of a dynamic team dedicated to achieving groundbreaking results in agentic AI.

  • Architectural Leadership
    • Design and evolve the architecture of ZVA and AIEA runtime services to ensure scalability, reliability, and performance.
    • Define and implement the agent runtime framework that supports multi-turn conversation understanding, contextual reasoning, and intelligent response generation.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate LLM-based reasoning and action orchestration into production systems.
  • Team Management
    • Lead and mentor a distributed team of AI researchers, software engineers, and system architects across multiple regions.
    • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

    • Ensure best practices in model deployment, runtime optimization, and system observability.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with product, research, and infrastructure teams to align AI capabilities with business objectives.
    • Communicate technical vision and progress to stakeholders and leadership teams.

job.title: Business Development Representative - Contact Center (CX)
job.description:
What You Can Expect​

As a Contact Center Business Development Representative, you'll own the top-of-funnel motion for Zoom Contact Center, one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important divisions in the company. You will engage directly with C-level and VP-level decision-makers at enterprise accounts, partnering with Account Executives to build and execute targeted outreach campaigns that drive pipeline.

This is a role where your domain expertise matters from day one. You'll bring existing knowledge of the CCaaS space, and in return, you'll have ownership of your outreach strategy, visibility with senior sales leadership, and a clear path to Account Executive.

If you're a relentless hunter who speaks CCaaS fluently, thrives on cold prospecting, and wants to work with best-in-class field teams on strategic account campaigns — this is where you build your career.

About the Team

Zoom Contact Center is our fastest-growing and most strategically important business and this BDR team is the engine behind it. We entered the Gartner Magic Quadrant for CCaaS in under three years, and we're only accelerating from here.

Our CX org operates with a startup feel inside an established brand — you'll have the backing of Zoom's scale and resources, and the visibility that comes with working on a product line where leadership is paying attention.

Responsibilities

  • Identifying and engage enterprise accounts that would benefit from Zoom Contact Center by leveraging targeted account lists and ABM campaigns.
  • Executing 70+ outbound activities daily, including cold calls, emails, video messages, and LinkedIn outreach.
  • Working with Zoom CX Specialists, Field Marketing, geo BDRs, and ABM teams to craft and execute highly targeted account-based campaigns.
  • Identifying and qualify Zoom Contact Center opportunities by conducting discovery calls and understanding a prospect’s contact center needs.
  • Developing compelling, account-specific messaging to engage C- level executives and VPs in Customer Experience (CX), IT, and Operations.
  • Maintaining accurate records in Salesforce (SFDC) and contribute to Zoom’s enterprise pipeline growth.
  • Tracking weekly and monthly performance, proactively adjusting strategies based on results and feedback.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated previous experience working with contact center solutions, CCaaS, or customer experience technologies.
  • Have excellent customer service skills and sales acumen.
  • Work with multiple teams (CX Specialists, Sales, Field Marketing, ABM, Geo BDRs) to refine sales strategies.
  • Deliver in high-volume outbound prospecting, with the ability to handle rejection and adapt strategies.
  • Experience engaging C-level and VP executives, using consultative selling and personalized messaging.
  • Success in achieving or exceeding quarterly BDR quotas and contributing to pipeline growth.

Compensation

Approximately 65,000−120,000 OTE annually, based on a standard 40-hour work week. This is a non-exempt position eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable law.

job.description:
What You Can Expect

We are building pipeline at scale in a market that's rapidly maturing. As a Commercial BDR, you will identify buyers, test strategies, and drive revenue growth.

This role requires proactive engagement, continuous improvement, and ownership of activities. You will directly shape our market approach within the Commercial segment.

About the Team

Common Room is an AI platform that consolidates buyer signals into one view, enabling teams to identify targets, craft messages, and determine timing effectively.

Supported by over $50M in funding from investors like Greylock, Index, and Madrona, Common Room is now part of Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA).

Responsibilities

  • Driving outbound pipeline generation across a high-volume account portfolio through focused prospecting using email, phone, and LinkedIn.
  • Conducting in-depth research and formulating a clear hypothesis outlining how Common Room resolves a particular business issue for the prospect.
  • Testing messaging, analyzing effectiveness, and applying insights across prospect lists ensuring consistent improvement in conversion rates.
  • Managing a dynamic pipeline with effective time prioritization—organizing tasks across a diverse account base and advancing leads through the funnel efficiently.
  • Partnering closely with Commercial Account Executives, aligning messaging, coordinating outreach, and ensuring seamless, well-qualified handoffs.
  • Utilizing sales engagement and CRM tools to maintain precise records, execute organized sequences, and monitor performance effectively.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrate strength in BDR tasks with proficiency in outbound fundamentals, including prospecting, addressing objections, and successfully scheduling meetings.
  • Operate effectively in a dynamic setting while maintaining consistent quality and adhering to standards, even when managing high levels of activity.
  • Understand how to research an account deeply and craft a relevant, insight-driven message tailored to their specific business context.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with sales engagement platforms such as Outreach or Salesloft and CRM tools like Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Treat data and performance metrics as inputs to improve — you track what's working and adjust quickly.
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment where you own your results and don't wait to be told what to do next.

We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.


Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.


If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.


Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.
